In fairly short order, they meet up with an old foe who turns out to be a friend, and a couple of enemies, who will have a much greater role to play in Return of the Jedi. A series of adventures ultimately winds up with our heroes crash-landing on Hoth, searching for a treasure which may or may not exist.

title: Fury (1994) #1
description: A Special One-Shot! Learn the hidden origins of Nick Fury and S.H.I.E.L.D.!

title: Secret Defenders (1993) #15
description: Sorcerer Supreme Doctor Strange enlists the help of Dr. Druid when a mystical threat approaches Earth. Will Earth’s most powerful mystics be able to defend the planet from the occult? Enter Malachi and the Shadowoman!

title: War Machine (1994) #2
description: "Between Deathlok and a Hard Case" War Machine continues to battle the Advisor and Eda Arul. But before loose ends are tied up, Deathlok appears on the scene!

title: X-Men 2099 (1993) #8
description: The X-Men and the Freakshow discover a common enemy and Mama Hurricane gives Xi'an a very important gift!

title: Cosmic Powers (1994) #3
description: Ganymede of the Spinsterhood may be the key to defeating Tyrant. But will Terrax and Thanos be able to strike an alliance? Jack of Hearts finds himself falling for Ganymede, but her vows prevent love from taking hold. Will the two say no to Thanos…and live?

title: Marvels (1994) #4
description: Even whilst enjoying some success upon getting his first book published, Photographer, Phil Sheldon, continues to be involved with the heroic "Marvels" and the villains of New York City. Don't miss out on this shocking conclusion to Marvels!

title: Marvel Comics Presents (1988) #151
description: Steel Raven and Typhoid Mary team-up to ‘punish’ men who have abused their wives.  Typhoid’s damaging shrink is exposed. Mary, and all her personalities, make a vow to protect the rights of women!

title: What If? (1989) #60
description: A special What If? issue spotlighting Phoenix and Cyclops’s relationship! What if Jean Grey and Scott Summers had married earlier? What if the two had never fallen in love? And what if Jean had chosen Wolverine over Cyclops?

title: Spider-Man 2099 (1992) #18
description: Lyla reacts in a jealous rage after Miguel and Dana share an intimate moment. Gabe retreats into virtual reality following his breakup with Kasey. Plus, a special story featuring Miguel O’ Hara from his school days! You’ll never believe what the X-Mansion of 2099 looks like!

title: Captain America (1968) #426
description: FIGHTING CHANCE BOOK 2 Cap is in for the fight of his life, but it may cost him much more than that. FIGHTING CHANCE is heating up!

title: Hawkeye (1994) #4
description: It all comes down to this! Hawkeye and his new ally Rover have their final showdown with the Secret Empire!

title: Spider-Man: The Mutant Agenda (1994) #2
description: Spider-Man and Beast, captives of the Brand Corporation! Plus, what happens when the Hobgoblin comes to possess the mutant-creating serum pioneered by Brand?

title: Silver Sable & the Wild Pack (1992) #23
description: Featuring Deadpool!

title: Venom: The Enemy Within (1994) #3
description: Mayoral candidate Charles Palentine proves to be harboring a dark secret. Venom and Morbius vs. Demogoblin and his entire goblin army!

title: Incredible Hulk Vs. Venom (1994) #1
description: Venom (Eddie Brock) and the Hulk make for a pretty great battle, but will an Earthquake threat from Dr. Bad Vibes prove to be the bigger problem?

title: New Warriors (1990) #46
description: When the X-Force and New Warriors try and free their captured friends from the Gamemaster, they are sucked into his elaborate plans as well! Can the Gamemaster really take down FOUR mutant teams with ONE twisted game?

title: The Punisher War Zone (1992) #26
description: The Punisher visits a tropical island to take on a drug kingpin, and he's not going to hold back.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy (1990) #47
description: Will the Beyonder prove victorious in his battle with Mephisto? The fate of Protégé hangs in the delicate balance.

title: Classic Star Wars (1992) #18
description: In the midst of a perilous "Paradise Detour," Luke continues his hunt for the missing S'ybll, while being pursued by what appears to be his old foe, the Night Beast. Eventually, the mystery of the successive unexplained appearances of Tanith Shire, the Night Beast, and Ben Kenobi is solved, and as it turns out, S'ybll has some very sinister, and selfish, plans for the young Jedi. Needless to say, Luke escapes S'ybll's clutches, after another Rebel rescue just in the nick of time. He, along with our other Rebel heroes, finally arrive at the new Rebel base on Hoth, ready for "A New Beginning." They're greeted there by a perturbed Princess Leia, who, before they can so much as look around, has another potentially dangerous mission for the unflappable Luke, Han, and Chewie.

title: Scarlet Witch (1994) #4
description: Master Pandemonium has one more trick up his sleeve! Scarlet Witch faces off against a fellow Nexus Being by the name of Lore. But why does Lore look identical to Scarlet Witch? Reality is threatened with a re-write as Wanda’s darkest nature is channeled through this new enemy!

title: X-Men 2099 (1993) #7
description: The fight between the X-Men and the Freakshow trudges on! And the X-Men learn about Avalon, a place where many mutants have been taken for protection.

title: War Machine (1994) #1
description: War Machine’s first issue in his 1994 ongoing series! First on the agenda? War Machine must take on Eda Arul and the Advisor! Plus, revelations about James Rhodes, the man behind the armored suit.

title: Marvel Comics Presents (1988) #150
description: Marvel Comics Presents the many faces of Typhoid Mary! What really goes on inside the head of Marvel’s most deranged? Wolverine tracks down Typhoid to seek her help in saving a mutant empath. A new personality, Bloody Mary, emerges.

title: Captain America (1968) #425
description: FIGHTING CHANCE BOOK 1 It all starts here! Witness the most startling event in the life of America's greatest hero as Cap battles for his life!

title: Marvels (1994) #3
description: See Silver Surfer, through the eyes and lens of Photographer Phil Sheldon. Witness the coming of the world-devouring Galactus in Book III of Marvels.  Can the Fantastic Four stop Galactus before he destroys the planet?

title: Spider-Man 2099 (1992) #17
description: Spider-Man 2099 dumped in Downtown! After an unsuccessful confrontation with imposter Thor, Spidey finds himself cursing his involvement in the battle for Valhalla. The Aesir battle for Mjolnir, but who is truly worthy? Plus, Doom 2099 pulls the wool over everyone’s eyes with a shocking coup!

title: The Punisher War Zone (1992) #25
description: Everyone descends on the small town of Laastekist hunting for the Punisher.

title: Punisher War Journal (1988) #64
description: With the help of the local sheriff, Punisher kills almost everyone who has chased him to the town of Lastekist; Lynn and Payback recover from injuries and decide to quit the Punisher game; Micro hooks up with Mickey and decides to try and rebuild his Punisher program with someone new.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy (1990) #46
description: The Beyonder and Mephisto duke it out to claim the Protégé!

title: Classic Star Wars (1992) #17
description: As the Rebels manage to escape the wrath of Darth Vader and the Imperials while escaping to Hoth, they discover that the Millennium Falcon didn't make it out of hyperspace. Crippled by a malfunctioning navigational computer, Luke Skywalker and friends land on the nearest planet, a veritable tropical paradise, to make repairs. Luke soon runs into a woman appearing to be Tanith Shire under attack from a carnivorous plant, and uses the Force to get out of a tight jam. But what's Tanith Shire doing alone on this mysterious outlying planet? The young Rebel is about to find out the real story behind "The Paradise Detour."

title: Scarlet Witch (1994) #3
description: Master Pandemonium transforms the West Coast Avengers into demonic beasts…and Scarlet Witch must pick up the pieces! Can Wanda Maximoff save her teammates from themselves? Pandemonium professes his undying love, leaving Scarlet Witch more determined than ever to eradicate her most dangerous foe.

title: X-Men Unlimited (1993) #4
description: Mystique assassinates General Armond Gaudier!

title: X-Men 2099 (1993) #6
description: Introducing... The Freakshow! The X-Men come across a woman called Mama Hurricane, who was a member of the mutant underground railroad. Xi'an hopes she many know of any underground mutant communities that may be still in existence.

title: The Punisher (1987) #88
description: The real Punisher is back in action…and he's ready to end the chaos of his doppelgangers.

title: Cosmic Powers (1994) #1
description: Thanos takes extreme measures to relieve his boredom- measures that involve mass murder! The cosmos tremble as the tyrant searches for a worthy combatant. Enter the cosmic playing field of Marvel’s mightiest galactic heroes! Who will be able to stop the Mad Titan?

title: Hawkeye (1994) #3
description: Hawkeye gets an all-new costume to help him take the fight to the Secret Empire! Plus, he gets a helping hand from none other than WAR MACHINE!

title: Spider-Man: The Mutant Agenda (1994) #1
description: A sensational team-up, both on and off the page! In this historic crossover between newspaper strip and comic book, Spider-Man and the Beast join forces to take down the Hobgoblin - with the fate of mutantkind in the balance!

title: Mort The Dead Teenager (1993) #4
description: Mort is in for the fight of his life when he takes on Death! Can this dead teenager win his freedom?

title: Venom: The Enemy Within (1994) #2
description: Venom and Morbius team up against a goblin invasion! Demogoblin ascends as a power player.

title: Ravage 2099 (1992) #15
description: THE FALL OF THE HAMMER PART 2 The X-Men of 2099 pay Ravage a visit. What will lead the X-Men to the hallowed halls of Valhalla? And will they uncover the truth about missing scientist Jordan Boone? Ravage may have the answer to this question and more!

title: New Warriors (1990) #45
description: The Gamemaster has his clan, the Upstarts, find and kill off former Hellions and New Mutants as part of a sick and twisted game. Will the former heroes be able to keep up with the game's ever changing rules to ensure their survival?

title: Warlock Chronicles (1993) #8
description: Will Thor's mind be restored with the help of...Thanos?!

title: Warlock and the Infinity Watch (1992) #25
description: The Watch vs. Thanos! Meanwhile, Odin does his best to cure Thor of his insanity, but his efforts prove in vain.

title: Spider-Man 2099 (1992) #16
description: THE FALL OF THE HAMMER PART 1 Has Thor truly returned to 2099? If so, the God of Thunder has lost his sense of honor! Spider-Man must take down an imposter Thor, and protect Dana from becoming a “sport of the gods”!

title: Marvels (1994) #2
description: News Photographer Phil Sheldon, takes on the task of reporting a story about New York City's very own super heroes.  A book giving a glimpse at modern day legends! Follow The Avengers from a new perspective, and experience shot-by-shot a tale that may just end up to be more for than the cameraman bargained for.

title: Hawkeye (1994) #2
description: Hawkeye finds himself caught in a struggle for survival against the (original) Secret Empire!

title: Punisher Invades The 'Nam: Final Invasion (1994) #1
description: Before he was the scourge of the underworld, Frank Castle was a soldier struggling to survive against all odds in Vietnam! Read about Castle's pre-Punisher days here!

title: X-Men (1991) #29
description: A Hellfire Club party becomes a deathtrap for the team!

title: Spider-Man: The Mutant Agenda (1994)
description: Re-live the origin of Spider-Man as brought to you by Stan Lee, John Romita and Larry Lieber! Plus, a collection of iconic moments from the wall-crawler’s history!

title: Mort The Dead Teenager (1993) #3
description: Is Mort's job working for Death turning him away from his old, human self?

title: Venom: The Enemy Within (1994) #1
description: Venom runs afoul of Morbius the Living Vampire!

title: Scarlet Witch (1994) #2
description: The Scarlet Witch’s nightmares become reality as she faces Master Pandemonium in Unity, New England. Will the delusional Master possess Wanda at long last? Plus, the town of Unity dislodges from the rest of America, becoming a floating island!

title: Punisher 2099 (1993) #13
description: THE FALL OF THE HAMMER PART 5 One for all? Will Jake Gallows, Punisher 2099, play nice with his new teammates? The Fall of the Hammer event continues as Punisher, along with 2099’s X-Men, Spider-Man, and Doom, save Asgard from Alechemax!

title: The Punisher War Zone (1992) #24
description: Presumed dead, Frank Castle skips town. Along the way, he meets a little girl whose father is a cop. How long can Punisher hide out in a tree house??

title: Punisher War Journal (1988) #63
description: The sheriff has made a mistake by cooping up Punisher in a cell…a horrible, grave mistake.

title: X-Force (1991) #31
description: Siryn is tricked by Juggernaut and her dying uncle, Black Tom Cassidy! Will she handle her family issues without turning to the bottle?

title: Guardians of the Galaxy (1990) #45
description: Starhawk and Aleta battle it out in a bid for total control.

title: Classic Star Wars (1992) #16
description: As Luke leads the Rebel fleet on its escape to its new base on Hoth, the Rebels' new allies, the Mon Calamari, plan a diversion to help them escape an Imperial blockade. But the Imperials soon realize that the Mon Calamari attacks are a diversion for the real Rebel escape, and they set off with the intent of destroying the Rebels once and for all. Meanwhile, Han, Chewie, and C-3PO take off in the Millennium Falcon to find an alternate escape route to Hoth, but what they discover is a seemingly impassable route that would take them dangerously close to a gigantic stellar flare!

title: Doom 2099 (1993) #14
description: THE FALL OF THE HAMMER PART 4 Doom 2099 must unite with 2099’s X-Men, Punisher, Spider-Man, and Ravage, to take down villains posing as Asgardian gods. Will this be a battle worthy of Valhalla? And do these imposters have the divine powers they claim to possess?

title: X-Men 2099 (1993) #5
description: After a series of fighting and defeating, the X-Men have one final battle--but can anyone beat the notorious Thor?

title: Captain Marvel (1994) #1
description: While at Empire State University, Captain Marvel must combat racism and violence brought on by the Sons of the Serpent.

title: The Punisher (1987) #87
description: Question: What's more terrifying than the Punisher? Answer: an army of Punishers!

title: Star Wars: Tales Of The Jedi (1993) #5
Warlock Chronicles (1993) #7
description: The Infinity Watch arrives in Asgard with a dire warning for Odin about his son.

title: Warlock and the Infinity Watch (1992) #24
description: Pip enters a duel of mortal combat to save the Watch from the wrath of angry trolls!

title: Spider-Man 2099 (1992) #15
description: THE RISE OF THE HAMMER Jordan Boone lets slip a valuable secret on Alchemax, and his lack of discretion costs him dearly. What is the Valhalla Project Boone spoke of? Miguel discovers that Lyla may have significant technical errors, while Conchata O’ Hara investigates Spider-Man on her own terms. Who are these new incarnations of Thor and Heimdall? And are they really immortal beings of Asgard?

title: Marvels (1994) #1
description: Phineas Horton was like a modern day Prometheus, stealing fire from heavens and handing a human torch down to man.  Writer, Kurt Busiek, and Artist, Alex Ross, tells the origin of The Human Torch in stunning detail.  Don't miss out on this Epic storytelling event in Book I of Marvels!

title: Guardians of the Galaxy (1990) #44
description: The Guardians are shocked when they discover that Yondu's planet has been distorted beyond recognition.

title: Secret Defenders (1993) #11
description: It's time for the next wave of Secret Defenders to enter the fray! NORTHSTAR, and his blinding speed! NOVA, and his cosmic power! THE INCREDIBLE HULK, and his smashing strength! Together with Doctor Strange, the Sorcerer Supreme, these heroes will face the worst villain in all of the Marvel Universe - THANOS, the Mad Titan!

title: X-Men: The Wedding Album (1994) #1
description: Scott Summers and Jean Grey’s pre-wedding spotlight! Jubilee’s flippant attitude on love is changed when she reads Jean’s old diary. Witness Jean and Scott’s relationship as told through memories, and get an inside peek at the X-Men’s most memorable romance.

title: X-Men 2099 (1993) #4
description: Bloodhawk is taken by La Lunatica to be delivered to the Theatre of Pain! But we soon learn that La Lunatica isn't as villainous as we thought!

title: The Punisher (1987) #86
description: After mobsters decide to end their Punisher problem, Frank destroys their Manhattan tower and apparently dies along with them. This brings the unwanted attention of the F.B.I. and V.I.G.I.L. However, Punisher is not dead, and he struggles to remove himself from the rubble.

title: Star Wars: Tales Of The Jedi (1993) #4
Hawkeye (1994) #1
description: The start of a pulse-pounding mini-series starring Marvel's premiere archer Avenger!

title: X-Men (1991) #28
description: Sabretooth's imprisonment at the X-Mansion raises concerns for the team.

title: 2099 Unlimited (1993) #3
description: Hulk 2099 must challenge a megalomaniacal villain by the name of Water God. Will Hulk be able to save refugees along the California border? Plus, Spider-Man 2099 must keep his identity safe from co-worker Anna Coye, but will Miguel O’ Hara’s secret lead to Anna’s demise?

title: Silver Surfer (1987) #88
description: Thor’s coming for Thanos...! But Silver Surfer and the Mind Valkyrie know how outmatched the Thunder God might be, so they rush to Thanos’ ship before any serious harm is done!

title: Mort The Dead Teenager (1993) #2
description: Mort starts his new job.  Unlike most teenagers who get a job at a supermarket or a restaurant, Mort gets a job working under Death himself!

title: Scarlet Witch (1994) #1
description: Scarlet Witch takes the stage in her own titular mini-series. After being plagued by horrifying nightmares, Wanda Maximoff seeks the mystical aid of mentor Agatha Harkness. Can Harkness unlock the inner sanctum of Wanda’s mind? And what hardships will Scarlet Witch endure when she discovers she is a ‘Nexus Being’?

title: Venom: The Madness (1993) #3
description: It's Venom vs. Juggernaut in the finale of "The Madness!" But Brock must also confront the psychic demons that are laying waste to his mind!

title: X-Men Annual (1991) #3
description: The X-Men attempt to rescue Storm from Shinobi Shaw. Meanwhile, Hydra holds Banshee’s old Interpol pal hostage!

title: The Punisher War Zone (1992) #23
description: Punisher is in a skyscraper full of mobsters and figures the best way to bring them all down is to blow it up, even though he is still inside.

title: Punisher War Journal (1988) #62
description: With Punisher believed dead under a collapsed building, Lynn and Payback begin trying to fill his shoes.

title: X-Force (1991) #30
description: Arcade is one messed up menace- if Shatterstar and Adam X don't kill one another, then Shatterstar's wife will pay with her life! In Ireland, Siryn and Warpath are greeted by some unwanted company at Cassidy Keep…

title: Warlock Chronicles (1993) #6
description: Moondragon and Adam try to cure Maxam of his amnesia...unsuccessfully.

title: X-Men Unlimited (1993) #3
description: Former Weapon-X project Maverick begins his merciless hunt for Sabretooth. Will the X-Men be able to assist in his endeavor? And with Wolverine in Japan, will the news of Creed’s rampage reach Logan too late? Guest-starring Rogue, Bishop, and Gambit, as they try to stop Sabretooth dead in his tracks!

title: Warlock and the Infinity Watch (1992) #23
description: Warlock and Pip save Silver Surfer from Thor, and must continue to subdue the insane god after the attack!

title: Spider-Man 2099 (1992) #14
description: Miguel O’ Hara learns the laws of reality don’t exist in Interspace. Gabe O’Hara discovers a shocking development with his girlfriend Kasey. And Net Prophet shows the full range of his reality-warping powers. Will Spider-Man finally escape Interspace?

title: Peter Parker, the Spectacular Spider-Man (1976) #207
description: Spider-Man and Shroud go up against the Screaming Masks of Cytorrak! Plus: A very special J. Jonah Jameson story!

title: Uncanny X-Men (1963) #307
description: Beast, Xavier and USAgent defend themselves against the Genoshan Magistrates. Meanwhile, Sersi and Exodus battle it out while Quicksilver and Jean Grey look for a way into Genosha's capitol to save Luna from Cortez's clutches.

title: Avengers West Coast (1985) #101
description: Going against the UN's orders, the Avengers team arrives on Genosha. Soon after arriving, the team is met with a powerful man with a familiar vendetta against humans. It seems the team may be in for the fight of their lives!

title: Avengers (1963) #369
description: With S.H.I.E.L.D and the Avengers deployed to Genosha, it seems that Cortez's plans have failed. With the appearance of a dangerous and powerful stranger however, things may not go the way the Avengers may hope. Is he friend of foe?

title: Classic Star Wars (1992) #15
description: It's finally time for some honest-to-goodness "Star Wars," as Luke Skywalker and Vrad Dodonna head for a climactic showdown in space with Darth Vader. Meanwhile, the rest of the Rebel Alliance struggles against time to evacuate Yavin Base for their new home on Hoth, as Darth Vader and the Imperial forces plan for a major strike on the Rebel moon. Luke, however, suspects that Vrad is a traitor to the Rebel cause, which leads to an exciting confrontation, as well as a startling turn of events for one of our Rebel heroes!

title: Silver Surfer (1987) #87
description: Adam Warlock and Silver Surfer enlist the help of Doctor Strange to take down the mad Thor.

title: Mort The Dead Teenager (1993) #1
description: When Mort gets challenged by the “cool kid” in school to race his dad’s car, Mort crashes the car into a train and dies. He then meets Teen Death, the Grim Reaper’s son, and mayhem ensues.

title: Venom: The Madness (1993) #2
description: Venom wakes up to a strange being attempting to merge with him after being exposed to a vat of ‘sentient' mercury. Eddie's growing relationship with Beck is threatened by his rogue symbiote.

title: Wolverine and The Punisher: Damaging Evidence (1993) #3
description: Wolverine and The Punisher team up against Damage and the Kingpin to put an end to his merciless killing. Defeated, Kingpin must now face Donald Pierce!

title: Lethal Foes of Spider-Man (1993) #4
description: United by nothing but their HATRED for one man and their thirst for POWER, murderous individuals band together to further their twisted goals. And they will let NOTHING stand in their way! Stan Lee presents the finale of...The Lethal Foes of Spider-Man!

title: Uncanny X-Men (2016) #14
description: Magneto and his team of X-Men discover who’s been weaponizing mutants and aiming them at mutantkind’s enemies. But once they do, the question becomes: Will they stop their longtime adversary once more…or JOIN HIM??

title: Invincible Iron Man (2015) #14
description: CIVIL WAR II TIE-IN! A blistering new chapter in the Iron Man mythos. After the shocking conclusion of CIVIL WAR II, a young woman answers the call and takes the mantle of Iron Man. And her surprising relationship to Tony Stark will define the book for years to come. Meet Riri Williams…she is Iron Man. Well, for now. She’s still working on the name. But the Marvel Universe WILL NEVER BE THE SAME AGAIN.

title: Death of X (2016) #1
description: What happened eight months ago that set the Inhumans and X-Men on a collision course? Find out here! The Inhumans travel to Japan where one of the Terrigen Clouds creates a shocking new Inhuman. The X-Men travel to Muir Island where the second Terrigen Cloud causes something truly terrible. When these two events collide, a war of catastrophic proportions explodes!

title: Doctor Strange: The Fate of Dreams Prose Novel (Hardcover)
description: The world is falling apart. Violent crime is surging while the global economy craters. Doctor Stephen Strange, the Sorcerer Supreme, has defeated demonic hordes, battled evil wizards and tirelessly defended our realm against invading inter-dimensional armies. But when a dangerous dream begins inspiring normal people to act out their darkest ambitions, even Doctor Strange is pushed to his very limits. Working alongside his longtime nemesis, Nightmare, the Sorcerer Supreme must delve into the nightmares, delusions and desires of an entire planet. To save the Dream Realms, he'll have to give up some illusions of his own - including his heroism. And in the fallout, what dreams will haunt the Sorcerer Supreme?

title: Enchanted Tiki Room (2016) #1
description:
AN ALL-NEW ADVENTURE IN THE TIKI, TIKI, TIKI ROOM!
Welcome to the Enchanted Tiki Room, a place of legend…of fantasy…and mystery. Here — on an isolated island populated by talking (and singing) birds and plants and ancient Tiki gods — almost anything can happen and does. As the next boat arrives with new visitors, what stories will unfold, what mysteries will be revealed and how are they all connected? Summer ain’t over yet, so grab your flip-flops, pop open your beach chair and book your vacation with the latest Disney Kingdoms series!

title: Spider-Man: Clone Saga Omnibus Vol. 1 (Hardcover)
description: One of the most explosive sagas in comics history! Peter Parker's world is rocked like never before by the return of his clone, long thought dead. For years, the clone has lived in peace as "Ben Reilly," but now he will be drawn back into wall-crawling action as the Scarlet Spider! But who or what is Kaine? Both Peter and Ben will be caught in a web of death spun by the Jackal, and their power and responsibility will be tested to the limits as the villain's game of smoke and mirrors raises the question: just who is the real Amazing Spider-Man? COLLECTING: WEB OF SPIDER-MAN (1985) #117-125, AMAZING SPIDER-MAN (1963) #394-401, SPIDER-MAN (1990) #51-58, SPECTACULAR SPIDER-MAN (1976) #217-224, SPIDER-MAN UNLIMITED (1993) #7-9.

title: Squadron Supreme (2015) #12
description: CIVIL WAR II TIE-IN! THE FINAL CHAPTER OF “FINDING NAMOR”! The saga continues as the SQUADRON SUPREME try to stop WARRIOR WOMAN from resurrecting their sworn enemy, NAMOR — but nothing has gone to plan. Unable to help their allies, HYPERION and DOCTOR SPECTRUM are forced to watch as the stakes rise against them…with BLUR and THUNDRA pitted against SPIDER-MAN and the entirety of S.H.I.E.L.D. On his own, NIGHTHAWK hunts the precognitive Inhuman named ULYSSES, intent to discover whatever secrets his visions hold.

title: All-New Wolverine (2015) #13
description:
“ENEMY OF THE STATE II” STARTS NOW!
WOLVERINE: MURDERER!!! Laura has fought so hard to be something other than what she was created to be, but the fight is over. Wolverine has blood on her hands. In the wake of an unspeakable tragedy, dark forces have Laura’s life under their control. Will Laura be able to defeat demons on the outside and from within? Or will she be forced to give up the hero’s life she’s built for herself?

title: Deadpool: Back in Black (2016) #1 (Liefield Sketch Variant)
The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl Beats Up the Marvel Universe (Hardcover)
description: Proof that we're living in the best of all possible worlds: THERE'S GONNA BE A SQUIRREL GIRL GRAPHIC NOVEL! It's a stand-alone adventure that's both great for new Squirrel Girl readers, and also for people who ALREADY know about how she can talk to squirrels and also punch really well! Behold: a story so HUGE it demanded a graphic novel! A story so NUTS that it incorporates BOTH senses of that word (insanity AND the weird hard fruit thingies) (they're fruits, did you know that?) (I didn't until I looked them up just now, so looks like we're all learning science from this solicit text for a comic book!) Squirrel Girl has defeated Thanos, Galactus, and Doctor Doom. TWICE. But in this all-new graphic novel, she'll encounter her most dangerous, most powerful, most unbeatable enemy yet: HERSELF. Specifically, an evil duplicate made possible through mad science (both computer and regular) as well as some Bad Decisions. In other words, SQUIRREL GIRL BEATS UP THE MARVEL UNIVERSE! YES. I CAN'T WAIT, AND I'M THE GUY WRITING IT.

title: Spider-Man 2099 (2015) #16
description: CIVIL WAR II TIE-IN! Caught in the clutches of the malignant CEO of ALCHEMAX, the future looks bleak for Spider-Man and his allies. And with S.H.I.E.L.D. and the Public Eye waging ALL-OUT WAR against anyone with super-powers, the heroes have little hope of rescue. Can Spidey and his friends find a way to escape and set the timeline right?

title: Scarlet Witch (2015) #11
description: The SCARLET WITCH travels to SERBIA to dive deep into her Romany roots! Who were her parents? Where does she come from? Wanda will discover the answers...and seek her revenge!

title: Hawkeye Vol. 3 (Hardcover)
description: Team Hawkeye head back to the future! Kate Bishop and Clint Barton are thrown together in a new adventure spanning three eras! First, past and present lives collide as Kate and Clint face a threat that will challenge everything they know about what it means to be Hawkeye. Barton and Bishop race against time to save a group of innocent kids with devastating powers. But will their actions cause a deep-seated rift that stretches across time? Find out as we head to the future to join old man Clint and a wiser Kate as they are reluctantly reunited. As tomorrow's Hawkeyes confront the Mandarin, today's must discover what makes a hero and what breaks a hero. It's more than just a bow and arrows. COLLECTING: ALL-NEW HAWKEYE (2015A) #1-5, ALL-NEW HAWKEYE (2015B) #1-6.

title: Deadpool & the Mercs for Money (2016) #4 (Mckone Variant)
Enchanted Tiki Room (2016) #1 (Grandt Orange Bird Variant)
Jessica Jones (2016) #1 (Veregge Black Panther 50th Anniversary Variant)
Power Man & Iron Fist Epic Collection: Revenge! (Trade Paperback)
description:
Payback time! But for the Heroes For Hire, vengeance cuts both ways. When the killing machine known as Warhawk beats Danny to a pulp, Luke will take his pound of flesh in return. But he's not the only one out to settle a score. The terrifying tag-team of Sabretooth and Constrictor are old foes out for blood, and to get the message across they target Power Man and Iron Fist's friends! And they're not Luke and Danny's only headache, as the heroes take on the malignant Mole Man and the mountain climbing Montenegro! 
COLLECTING: POWER MAN AND IRON FIST #71-72, #74-89; DAREDEVIL (1964) #178.

title: Deadpool & the Mercs for Money (2016) #4 (Johnson Story Thus Far Variant)
Champions (2016) #1
description: Following the fallout of CIVIL WAR II, Avengers Ms. Marvel, Nova and Spider-Man strike out on their own — joined by Cyclops, Viv Vision and the Totally Awesome Hulk! Six young heroes determined to change the world — and they’re only the beginning!

title: Cage! (2016) #1
description: From the Award-Winning creator of Dexter’s Laboratory, Samurai Jack and Hotel Transylvania! On the mean streets of Harlem, shoes are big, shirts are large, bottoms are belled and crime is rampant! But in the heart of the city, the world’s hardest-working, smack-talking, chain-wearing super hero is on the street and on the case! And his rates are reasonable! He’s CAGE! and he’ll save your behind. Dig it!

title: Vote Loki (Trade Paperback)
description: Loki is many things: god, trickster, brother, son, villain, even hero. Now he wants to add one more title to the list: President of the United States! That's right, the God of Lies wants to be ruler of the free world! But is this just another scheme? One fact is certain: With Loki's winning smile and silver tongue on the campaign trail, this election just got a lot more interesting! He'll soon have the American people eating out of the palm of his hand, but can would-be President Laufeyson sway the media? And what will be his response when the heroes of Earth launch their attack ad? A crisis in Latveria offers Loki the chance to demonstrate his foreign policy...but surely he wouldn't cause a national catastrophe just for a little good press? Would he? COLLECTING: VOTE LOKI #1-4; MATERIAL FROM JOURNEY INTO MYSTERY #85, AVENGERS (1963) #300.

title: Deadpool: Too Soon? Infinite Comic (2016) #7
description: Squirrelpool is back – and she’s ANGRY! Meanwhile, Deadpool continues the search for the mysterious murderer killing all of his funny comic book comrades. The answer may be closer to home than he thinks!

title: Spidey (2015) #11
description: Spidey has had a lot of villains in his early days, but none were designed to hate him more than Mac Gargan, the Scorpion! So why is this Spider-Man/Scorpion battle so different from the others? All this, plus: Peter Parker and Flash Thompson…BFF?!

title: Doctor Strange Vol. 2: The Last Days of Magic (Hardcover)
description: Doctor Strange enters the last days of magic! They have crossed the dimensions, purging them all of sorcery, one by one. Now the Empirikul have arrived in the Marvel Universe. And with Earth's Master of the Mystic Arts weakened beyond measure, is there any chance of stopping them? The Sorcerer is no longer Supreme, and he will find himself at the mercy of the Imperator! With his magic destroyed, and his world on the brink of disaster, are there any more tricks left up Doctor Strange's sleeves? Jason Aaron and Chris Bachalo's sensational reinvigoration of a Marvel legend continues! COLLECTING: DOCTOR STRANGE (2015) #6-10, DOCTOR STRANGE: LAST DAYS OF MAGIC #1.

title: Doctor Strange (2015) #12
description: “BLOOD IN THE AETHER” STARTS NOW! After the Empirikul destroyed almost all the world’s magic and nearly killed Doctor Strange, the Sorcerer Supreme must try and build himself back up. Witness the return of BARON MORDO! But what effect did the Empirikul attack have on him?!

title: Jessica Jones (2016) #1
description: She is back after a decade! A lot has changed in the Marvel Universe and there are still many secrets hiding in the shadows. Secrets only a special woman like Jessica Jones can hope to uncover. Discover the haunting secrets from Jessica’s past in this blistering new series. Alias Investigations is open for business.

title: The Uncanny X-Men Omnibus Vol. 2 (Hardcover)
description: Chris Claremont, Dave Cockrum and John Byrne took a little reprint series called X-MEN and turned it into the all-new, all-different titan that conquered comicdom. Now, you can experience the thrills and excitement of their classic tales from "The Dark Phoenix Saga" to "Days of Future Past" and so much more in this enormous Omnibus! COLLECTING: X-MEN (1963) #132-141, ANNUAL (1970) #4-5; THE UNCANNY X-MEN (1981) #142-153; AVENGERS ANNUAL (1967) #10; MARVEL FANFARE (1982) #1-4; MARVEL TREASURY EDITION (1974) #26-27; MARVEL TEAM-UP (1972) #100; BIZARRE ADVENTURES (1981) #27; PHOENIX: THE UNTOLD STORY (1984) #1.

title: Deadpool: Back in Black (2016) #1 (Contest of Champions Game Variant)
Color Your Own Doctor Strange (Trade Paperback)
description: By the Hoary Hues of Hoggoth! Marvel's most psychedelic super hero has been stripped of all pigments, and left trapped in a world of black and white! The Sorcerer Supreme needs you to step forward and take your place as Earth's Colorist Complete! So grab your pens, pencils or crayons and prepare to brandish them like the Wand of Watoomb, working your magic on page after page of wonderful line art starring Strange and his greatest friends and foes! In no time, you'll be incanting the Shades of the Seraphim, the Crimson Bands of Cyttorak and the Ruby Rings of Raggadorr! But worry not if you struggle to keep your kaleidoscope of color inside the lines - after all, beauty is in the Eye of Agamotto!

title: Marvel Universe Avengers: Ultron Revolution (2016) #4
description: BRUCE BANNER…UNHULKED?! After a nuclear accident, Bruce Banner is stripped of his angry alter ego — the Incredible Hulk! Can THE AVENGERS figure out how to bring the big green monster back? And if they can, will they want to?

title: Ultimate Spider-Man Infinite Comic (2016) #10
description: Spider-Man teams up with Doctor Strange, Spider-Girl and Spider-Ham to stop Shazana, a mysterious sorceress whose spells have been displacing spider people from their own dimensions! Unfortunately, her efforts have disrupted a hip hop Broadway musical about a major player in American history; and no, it’s not the one you’re thinking of! To make matters worse, Shazana’s dimension disrupting has also manifested a small army of villainous characters from your favorite non-license-violating Broadway musicals!

title: Captain Marvel (2016) #9
description: CIVIL WAR II TIE-IN! Captain Marvel thought she had it figured out—change the future and save lives. But as friendships turn cold, she has to decide how far she’s willing to go…

title: X-Men: Apocalypse Wars (Hardcover)
description: As mutantkind's oldest enemy haunts the X-Men once again, three teams face war on multiple fronts, across different eras! The All-New X-Men are on a mission to write their own futures - especially Evan Sabahnur, destined to one day become Apocalypse! Trapped in Ancient Egypt, is he willing to escape his fate by changing the course of history? A thousand years from now, the Extraordinary X-Men are Homo superior's last hope against Apocalypse - but his newest Horseman is one of their own! And the Uncanny X-Men are drawn into the fray when Archangel once again assumes the guise of Death. Does this mean Apocalypse is rising again in the present - or will Magneto's team face a new kind of Genocide? Collecting ALL-NEW X-MEN (2015) #9-11, EXTRAORDINARY X-MEN #8-12 and UNCANNY X-MEN (2016) #6-10.

title: Captain America: Steve Rogers (2016) #5 (Chen Marvel Tsum Tsum Takeover Variant)
Captain America: Sam Wilson Vol. 2 - Standoff (Trade Paperback)
description: For years, across two eras, Steve Rogers wielded his red, white and blue shield against unspeakable odds. For a time when he fell, his brother in arms Bucky Barnes picked it up. And when it was time to rest for good, Steve handed it to his friend Sam Wilson. Now all three men who were and are Captain America must unite for a heroic Standoff with the evil that lurks in Pleasant Hill! It's a tale of Caps past and present, 75 years in the making! And if Sam gets out of it alive, shield still in hand, he'll face the Americops, who have their own definition of law and order! Whatcha gonna do when they come for you? Plus: stories celebrating the legacy and legend of Captain America throughout history! COLLECTING: Captain America: Sam Wilson #7-8, Assault on Pleasant Hill Alpha, Assault on Pleasant Hill Omega.

title: Nova (2015) #11
description: Sam Alexander has led a busy life as NOVA, but after all of his intergalactic gallivanting, is it time to hang up the helmet?

title: Thunderbolts (2016) #5
description: CIVIL WAR II TIE-IN! It’s the Winter Soldier versus Spider-Man and only one of them is going to walk away.

title: Shang-Chi: Master of Kung Fu Omnibus Vol. 2 Cassaday Cover (Hardcover)
description:
Shang-Chi: Master of Kung Fu easily ranks as one of the most iconic series in Marvel history. Doug Moench and Paul Gulacy's blend of kung-fu action and globe-trotting espionage raised the already high standard set by the title, and in this second volume, believe it or not, it gets even better! The cinematic Hong Kong showdown with Shen Kuei, the Cat; the tense "Oriental Expediters;" the mystery of MI-6's mole; the sweeping scale of "The Return of Fu Manchu"; the epic "Saga of War-Yore"; each effort is a masterpiece of action, intrigue and drama, and none has ever looked better than in this painstakingly restored Omnibus. 
COLLECTING: MASTER OF KUNG FU (1974) #38-70; MASTER OF KUNG FU ANNUAL (1976) #1.

title: Marvel Universe Doctor Strange (Digest)
description: By the Vishanti! It's Doctor Stephen Strange in exciting adventures of magic and mysticism. And the Doctor is "in" for some of Marvel's other greatest heroes! But can Spider-Man and Iron Fist help him put a stop to the demon named Nightmare, before he puts the whole world into an endless sleep? Will Hulk and Strange defend the Earth from the Dread Dormammu? And when Captain America vaults in, will shield and sorcery be enough to stop a soul-devouring monster? Plus, the Doc will go it solo for another round with Dormammu, and take Spidey on a mind-bending journey across the realities! Strange tales one and all, for the whole family to enjoy! COLLECTING: MARVEL UNIVERSE ULTIMATE SPIDER-MAN #21; MARVEL ADVENTURES HULK #5; MARVEL ADVENTURES SUPER HEROES (2008) #5, #9; MATERIAL FROM MARVEL ADVENTURES SUPER HEROES (2010) #21.

title: Spider-Man/Deadpool (2016) #9
description: "ITSY BITSY” STARTS NOW! Her name is ITSY BITSY and she’s Spider-Man and Deadpool’s WORST NIGHTMARE! A reminder – EVERY issue of this series has sold out SEVERAL times. Don’t let the issue be spoiled while you wait for the third or fourth print of this book! Call your retailer and reserve your copy now!

title: Guidebook To The Marvel Cinematic Universe - Marvel's Avengers: Age Of Ultron (2016) #1
description: When the threat of Ultron rears its computerized head, the Avengers must assemble once again — and the MCU Guidebook is right there with them! Our comprehensive coverage of the fan-favorite Marvel Studios films and Marvel Television shows continues as we reveal everything you need to know about Earth's Mightiest Heroes' second big-screen blockbuster! With fact sheets, movie-to-comic comparisons and behind-the-scenes production art and stills, this issue is packed with profiles and updates on the Avengers themselves — Captain America, Iron Man, Thor, Black Widow, Hawkeye and Hulk — as well as allies and new members including Quicksilver, Scarlet Witch, War Machine, Falcon and Vision! And don't forget Ultron himself! Plus: Nick Fury! Loki's scepter! And more! Relive the thrills of Marvel's Avengers: Age of Ultron, and continue building your indispensable library of Cinematic Universe reference books!

title: Spider-Gwen (2015) #12
description: Here it is! SPIDER-GWEN vs. FRANK CASTLE. No more powers, no more running, no more hiding.

title: New Avengers (2015) #16
description: CIVIL WAR II TIE-IN! The A.I.M. vs. S.H.I.E.L.D. vs. W.H.I.S.P.E.R. war screams towards a heart-shredding climax! It’s a battle to the finish aboard a crashing Air Force One! And no matter who wins, Marvel-Earth will never be the same! WE BEG OF YOU, TRUE BELIEVER—DO NOT REVEAL THE SHOCKING TWISTS WITHIN THESE PAGES TO MAN OR BEAST!

title: Civil War II: Kingpin (2016) #3
description: Wilson Fisk has reason to believe that one of his own men is staging a coup—and killing those who won’t surrender their loyalty. But mutiny becomes the least of Fisk’s worries when the Punisher launches an attack on the Kingpin’s safe house. Can the Fisk keep his business afloat with his cronies dropping like flies, and Frank Castle gunning for him, or is this finally the end of the reign of the KINGPIN?

title: CIVIL WAR II: ULYSSES INFINITE COMIC (2016) #6
description: Ulysses confronts Karnak and discovers the outcome of his horrible vision!

title: Nighthawk (2016) #5
description: CIVIL WAR II TIE-IN! It’s the Winter Soldier versus Spider-Man and only one of them is going to walk away.

title: Web Warriors (2015) #11
description: FINAL ISSUE FREE-FOR-ALL! AN ASTOUNDING ASSEMBLY OF ARACHNIDS ALL IN ONE PLACE FOR YOU TO ENJOY! But will all of them survive?!

title: Deadpool Annual (2016) #1
description: Discover…the secret, unearthed, never-before-viewed pilot…of DEADPOOL AND HIS INSUFFERABLE PALS! Featuring…wait, Iceman and Firestar? This isn’t right…

title: Spider-Man: The Complete Clone Saga Epic Book 1 (Trade Paperback)
description: Spider-Man's clone is back - and the real Spidey is beside himself! Peter thought his clone was long dead, but where has Ben Reilly been for the last five years? Why has he returned? Is he Peter Parker's dark side...or his better half? And does Miles Warren, the unbalanced Jackal, have anything to do with it? Everyone wants answers, and the cloaked killer Kaine is ready to rip them out of whoever has them! Plus: Venom and Vermin! Carnage and Chameleon! New allies, new enemies and a new crime-fighting identity! No other Spider-storyline was as innovative or infamous as the 1990s Clone Saga, and you can follow it right from the start! COLLECTING: SPIDER-MAN: THE LOST YEARS #0-3, WEB OF SPIDER-MAN (1985) #117-119, AMAZING SPIDER-MAN (1963) #394, SPIDER-MAN (1990) #51-53, SPECTACULAR SPIDER-MAN (1976) #217, MATERIAL FROM SPIDER-MAN UNLIMITED (1993) #7.

title: X-Men '92 (2016) #7
description: Lilapalooza has gone off the rails as the X-Men have been teleported into space! Now, they face some old enemies made new as THE BROOD attack! Meanwhile, on Earth, The Toadies keep rocking as X-Factor comes knocking!

title: Captain America: Sam Wilson (2015) #13
description: CIVIL WAR II TIE-IN! Captain America vs. U.S.Agent! No more waiting: #takebacktheshield

title: Ultimates (2015) #11
description: CIVIL WAR II TIE-IN! The Ultimates are at war – with each other! Can they solve their problems and come together in time to face the real threat...or will Thanos and his new acolyte destroy them all?

title: The Amazing Spider-Man Omnibus Vol. 2 (Hardcover)
description: The Stan Lee/John Romita era starts here! Lee and Romita transformed the web-slinger into Marvel's top title with stories that raised your spirits, tore at your heartstrings and kept you on the edge of your seat. From the revelation of the Green Goblin's secret identity to the unforgettable entrance of Mary Jane Watson, these classics define Spidey to this day - with star-studded debuts including the Kingpin, the Rhino and Captain Stacy; Spidey's disastrous first tryout with the Avengers; the iconic "Spider-Man No More!" issue; and an epic battle against the Green Goblin! COLLECTING: AMAZING SPIDER-MAN (1963) #39-67, ANNUAL #3-5; SPECTACULAR SPIDER-MAN (1968) #1-2.

title: Rocket Raccoon & Groot (2016) #10
description: CIVIL WAR II TIE-INS! We don’t mean to be carpet-braggers, but you’ll have to (Ulysses S.) grant that these are the best issues of the entire event! When Rocket, Groot, and Gwenpool all go after the same bounty in Georgia, the results are antebellum-believable!

title: All-New, All-Different Avengers Vol. 2: Family Business (Trade Paperback)
description: Captain America, Iron Man, Thor, Vision, Spider-Man, Ms. Marvel and Nova are the All-New, All-Different Avengers - but can they stay together long enough to be more than a footnote in the team's great history? Maybe not, when the events of Standoff pit them against the Uncanny Avengers. Who will prove themselves the mightiest Avengers of all? Things get worse as the mysteries of Pleasant Hill deepen. The Avengers can't tell the heroes from the villains - and now they don't even recognize each other! How can they be effective as a team when their memories have been stolen? Plus, the Avengers must face someone new with an old name - one that goes right back to the beginning. Who is the all-different Wasp? And will she be friend or foe? COLLECTING: ALL-NEW, ALL-DIFFERENT AVENGERS #7-12.

title: Doctor Strange Annual (2016) #1
description: Clea comes back into Doctor Strange’s life as he’s picking up the pieces from the worst beating he’s ever taken. Clea’s going to make that battle look like a walk in the park. Also in this issue… WHO ARE THE SORCERERS SUPREME?!

title: Extraordinary X-Men (2015) #14
description: Nightcrawler and Iceman are scouring the globe for their teammate, Colossus, hoping to save him from the influence of Apocalypse…but it may be they’re the ones in need of rescue! Meanwhile, Storm and Magik run into trouble as they race across parallel dimensions in search of a missing young mutant…

title: Punisher War Journal (1988) #61
description: A high-level meeting of mobster family heads proves an irresistable target for Frank. He rigs the otherwise empty building with explosives and, with his hand on the dead man's switch, takes down everybody but one gangster. The man tries to bargain with Frank, saying they could both walk out. Seconds later, BOOM.

title: Lethal Foes of Spider-Man (1993) #4
description: United by nothing but their HATRED for one man and their thirst for POWER, murderous individuals band together to further their twisted goals. And they will let NOTHING stand in their way! Stan Lee presents the finale of...The Lethal Foes of Spider-Man!

title: Thor Corps (1993) #4
description: The Corps of Four conclude their takedown of Demonstaff! But not before learning the truth behind his descent into madness!

title: Guardians of the Galaxy (1990) #43
description: Woden, son of Thor, may be Asgard's only chance to turn the tide against Loki's invasion!

title: X-Men 2099 (1993) #3
description: When Junkpile returns to Las Vegas having captured two X-Men and Xi'an's cocoon, the other X-Men begin a reconnaissance mission!

title: The Punisher (1987) #85
description: V.I.G.I.L. takes aim at Punisher after their funding is threatened for failing to come up with any major arrests. Lt. Blackwell blames one man: Frank Castle. The Punisher must escape a web of smugglers and an organization with a vendetta against him.

title: Avengers: The Terminatrix Objective (1993) #4
description: The Avengers fight for eight millennia of time…right alongside Kang the Conqueror! Former foe becomes ally, as Earth's Mightiest and Kang battle Alioth, Master of all timespans! Don’t miss this pulse pounding conclusion to the Terminatrix Objective!

title: Star Wars: Tales Of The Jedi (1993) #3
Star Wars: Tales Of The Jedi (1993) #2
Spider-Man 2099 (1992) #13
description: Tyler Stone and Spider-Man under the will of Thanatos! What devious plans will Thanatos set into motion when he breaks into Alchemax’s Virtual Unreality Lab? And who is the mysterious figure from the Interspace Portal? Spider-Man vs. Thanatos in the Interspace!

title: Peter Parker, the Spectacular Spider-Man (1976) #206
description: Tombstone takes out anyone and everyone foolish enough to get in his way -- EVEN SPIDER-MAN!

title: Avengers (1963) #368
description: Things go from bad to worse when it is discovered that Cortez has assassinated the Genoshan government!  And who do the Avengers and X-Men factor in?

title: Infinity Crusade (1993) #6
description: The conclusion is here! One by one, stars in the Milky Way galaxy have begun to explode. Can the heroes save the universe? What role will Thanos come to play in the final act?

title: Deadpool: The Circle Chase (1993) #4
description: It's the final showdown between Deadpool and Weapon X in Nepal!

title: Lethal Foes of Spider-Man (1993) #3
description: The Web-Slinger is alone against seven of his deadliest foes. Win or lose, one thing is certain…Spidey's not getting out of this one unscathed.

title: Thor Corps (1993) #3
description: After Eric takes on the mantle of Thunderstrike, the one true Thor makes the Corps four on a multi-dimensional quest to rescue the wife of Dargo's arch-foe, Demonstaff!

title: Guardians of the Galaxy (1990) #42
description: Loki's malevolent siege of Asgard begins!

title: X-Men 2099 (1993) #2
description: After escaping the attackers from the Synge casino with the help of Bloodhawk, the X-men get to new hideout. But will the hideout be strong enough to hold off oncoming enemies?

title: Cage (1992) #20
description: The Thing and Human Torch assist Cage in freeing himself of the Bogeyman!

title: X-Force (1991) #28
description: Henry Gyrich tests Feral's patience with his blatant hatred of mutants. Will Feral set their differences aside and let Gyrich live to see another day?

title: Classic Star Wars (1992) #14
description: With the help of their new allies, the Mon Calamari, the Rebels battle the monstrous sea worms of Daluuj. Meanwhile, Darth Vader is cutting a swath of destruction toward the Rebel base on Yavin where Luke Skywalker and General Dodonna's son Vrad prepare for a suicide mission!

title: X-Men (1991) #26
description: Working against the clock, the X-Men fly to Genosha to help Xavier. During the journey Colossus must make a difficult decision concerning where his loyalties lie. Meanwhile, Xavier and Beast must bide their time by fighting against new enemies.

title: Silver Surfer (1987) #86
description: Silver Surfer must break up a brawl between an entirely insane Thor and Beta Ray Bill!

title: Avengers: The Terminatrix Objective (1993) #3
description: No matter where the Avengers time-leap, lethal time-trooper robots are on the assault! Terminatrix is up to no good in the Temple of Immortus- the fabric of time and space is in the balance, and only Kang the Conqueror’s return may save the universe.

title: Venom: The Madness (1993) #1
description: We all know Venom is a bit insane but in this story, he is LITERALLY going insane…with his personality split in two! A trippy tale told by Daredevil master scribe Ann Nocenti!

title: Wolverine and The Punisher: Damaging Evidence (1993) #2
description: Following through on his plans to tarnish The Punisher's reputation, Kingpin uses his agent Damage to impersonate Frank and kill innocent civilians.

title: Infinity Crusade (1993) #5
description: After teaming up with Drax The Destroyer to fight Thor, The Hulk is abandoned and left to drift in space above Paradise Omega. Can the Jade Giant make it back to the surface in time to join the action?

title: Deadpool: The Circle Chase (1993) #3
description: Deadpool versus Makeshift and Rive!  Can Wade survive two deadly lady mercenaries at once?

title: Spider-Man 2099 (1992) #12
description: Who is Thanatos? How did he achieve his warrior strength? And what beef does he have with Alchemax? Spider-Man 2099 meets a worthy opponent in battle, brawn, and fortitude! Jordan Boone finds himself in trouble yet again.

title: Peter Parker, the Spectacular Spider-Man (1976) #205
description: Tombstone is on the hunt! His first target -- Flash Thompson! Plus, a major change in the life of Peter Parker!

title: Classic Star Wars (1992) #13
description: Our Rebel heroes seek help from the Mon Calamari in evacuating their Yavin base, but soon get embroiled in a mystery involving a distress beacon of unknown origin, scads of Imperial troopers, giant sea worms, an amphibian rescue, more giant sea worms, a droid or two, a few more scads of Imperial troopers, and a bit more excitement that can't be contained!

title: 2099 Unlimited (1993) #2
description: What is the R-Gang of 2099, and what will they do to cause mischief? Plus, the return of Hulk 2099! Will John Eisenhart be able to escape his worst enemy yet - society at large?

title: Venom: Funeral Pyre (1993) #3
description: Venom and Punisher team up to kill a gang who murdered someone purely as an initiation right.

title: Wolverine and The Punisher: Damaging Evidence (1993) #1
description: Working separately Wolverine and Punisher are both led to a case involving the Kingpin. The Kingpin has plans to ruin Frank's reputation, but can the two stop them before it's too late?

title: Avengers: The Terminatrix Objective (1993) #2
description: Will Mistress of Time Terminatrix rely on the Avengers when she gets in over her head? Cap, Iron Man, and Thor battle it out with the men who once assumed their identities! Chronopolis rumbles as two time-warped Avengers teams assemble!

title: X-Men Annual (1991) #2
description: The X-Men encounter a dangerous “energy thief” by the name of Jonathan Chambers. Is Chambers man or mutant? And what is the end-goal of his theft of mutant powers? The answer will surprise you! Revanche makes a devastating admission that will change her future with the X-Men.

title: Lethal Foes of Spider-Man (1993) #2
description: Spider-Man has his back to the wall against this onslaught of foes! Doc Ock, Vulture, Rhino, and more are all determined to send Peter to a world of pain!

title: Thor Corps (1993) #2
description: Will the titanic trio of future Thor Dargo Ktor, Beta-Ray Bill and Thunderstrike, put their differences aside in time to knock Zarrko the Tomorrow Man into next week?

title: Guardians of the Galaxy (1990) #41
description: The Guardians discover that Loki has brainwashed the Inhuman people!

title: X-Men Annual (1991) #2
description: The X-Men encounter a dangerous “energy thief” by the name of Jonathan Chambers. Is Chambers man or mutant? And what is the end-goal of his theft of mutant powers? The answer will surprise you! Revanche makes a devastating admission that will change her future with the X-Men.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy (1990) #41
description: The Guardians discover that Loki has brainwashed the Inhuman people!

title: Thor Corps (1993) #2
description: Will the titanic trio of future Thor Dargo Ktor, Beta-Ray Bill and Thunderstrike, put their differences aside in time to knock Zarrko the Tomorrow Man into next week?

title: Spider-Man 2099 (1992) #11
description: When a vandal acts against criminal corporation Alchemax, the Public Eye will stop at nothing to teach a lesson! Enter Miguel O’ Hara to save the day. Will Spider-Man 2099 be able to outrun the technical weaponry of S.I.E.G.E.? And will Miguel and Dana get a much needed vacation?

title: Infinity Crusade (1993) #4
description: Earth's gathered champions are rocketing toward Paradise Omega, home of Adam Warlock's virtuous female doppleganger, the Goddess. Has she been slain? What is next for the heroes?

title: Deadpool: The Circle Chase (1993) #2
description: Deadpool must get through Juggernaut and Black Tom Cassidy in order to secure a mysterious case that holds the secret of Tolliver's will.

title: X-Men Unlimited (1993) #2
description: Magneto falls under the crosshairs of a dangerous assassin, a man called Adrian Eiskalt. Eiskalt blames Magneto for the death of his brother and will stop at nothing to destroy the Master of Magnetism.

title: X-Men (1991) #24
description: Gambit and Rogue's first date!

title: Warlock Chronicles (1993) #3
description: Mephisto knows how to use the Cosmic Cubes in ways no one was meant to use them. His price for the information: a Cosmic Cube once the Goddess is defeated. His customers? Thanos and Adam Warlock!

title: Lethal Foes of Spider-Man (1993) #1
description: Return of the SINISTER SYNDICATE! A band of Spidey's nemeses join together once more to take the Web-Head down -- but they've got more firepower this time out! One of Spider-Man's greatest foes enters the fray -- DOCTOR OCTOPUS!

title: Guardians of the Galaxy (1990) #40
description: Talon reveals his origins to his teammates!

title: Thor Corps (1993) #1
description: It's Hammer Brothers Time! Hammers clash when Mjolnir-wielder of the future Dargo Ktor is tricked into fighting Eric Masterson, the replacement Thor, in the modern day. As they bring the thunder, Beta Ray Bill joins the party with his mighty mallet Stormbreaker!

title: Avengers: The Terminatrix Objective (1993) #1
