title: Saga of the Sub-Mariner (1988) #11
description: Before she was a New Warrior, she was an Atlantean! Enter…Namorita!

title: Marvel Comics Presents (1988) #26
description: Contains Panther’s Quest Part 14: Somebody’s Going to Pay and Hulk in Splashdown. PANTHER’S QUEST PART 14: T’Challa attempts to rescue Miyo Moshigo from the Comrads.

title: New Mutants (1983) #78
description: As if the battle with Freedom Force from last issue wasn’t enough, now the New Mutants must confront the wrath of Hela! Doctor Strange guest-stars!

title: Doctor Strange, Sorcerer Supreme (1988) #6
description: As Baron Mordo pushes Doctor Strange to his absolute limits, the unthinkable happens -- Mordo summons MEPHISTO! Or maybe one of his closest kin?

title: Sensational She-Hulk (1989) #4
description: Jennifer Walters takes on one of the biggest challenges that face all of us! The dreaded job interview!

title: Wolverine (1988) #10
description: The flashback that's still starting storylines: one of Wolverine's earliest battles with Sabretooth! Decades ago, innocents paid the price for Sabretooth's hatred of Logan! Will history repeat itself in present-day Madripoor?

title: Saga of the Sub-Mariner (1988) #10
description: Namor Vs. The Thing...and Stingray!

title: Avengers West Coast (1985) #47
description: Scarlet Witch has a stalker on her trail, and she's terrified for her life! Who is this mysterious being watching her every move? And will the Witch be able to rely on the reconfigured Vision if she's truly down and out?

title: Marvel Comics Presents (1988) #25
description: Contains only Panther’s Quest Part 13: A Right to Kill. PANTHER’S QUEST PART 13: Chikane takes T’Challa to the home of Miyo Moshigo as they hide from the South African authorities.

title: Damage Control (1989) #4
description: Damage Control is recruited to clean-up Xavier’s School for Gifted Mutants. But as soon as Damage Control repairs, the Professor’s mutants destroy! Wolverine gets “pied” and laughter does not ensue.

title: Marvel Comics Presents (1988) #24
description: Contains only Panther’s Quest Part 12: Voices Heard, Voices Ignored. PANTHER’S QUEST PART 12: Zanti Chikane returns to the solar glider to help T’Challa recover from his wounds.

title: New Mutants (1983) #77
description: Brightwind flies once more! And that means Dani Moonstar, Mirage, must rise as a Valkyrie against Hel!

title: Doctor Strange, Sorcerer Supreme (1988) #5
description: BARON MORDO STRIKES! Strange's most persistent nemesis has a new trick up his sleeve -- and it just might cost Strange his soul!

title: Damage Control (1989) #3
description: A new set of uniforms and a new sales scheme threaten to destroy the whole Damage Control operation- and Iron Man!

title: Marvel Comics Presents (1988) #23
description: Contains only Panther’s Quest Part 11: The Official Version. PANTHER’S QUEST PART 11: Anton Pretorius and his Minister of Security appear on TV to issue a warning about the Black Panther, still at large!

title: Sensational She-Hulk (1989) #3
description: When Mysterio comes to start trouble, Spider-Man usually follows! In this special issue we see Spidey and She-Hulk join arms to take on the Headmen!

title: Strikeforce: Morituri (1986) #31
description: Will the Morituri's seizure of power mean worldwide stability or global civil war?

title: Doctor Strange & Doctor Doom: Triumph and Torment (1989)
description: Doctor Doom and Doctor Strange enter Mephisto's realm in an all-out effort to free the soul of Doctor Doom's mother! But what price must be paid before Mephisto will release it? And will Doctor Doom make the sacrifice?

title: Saga of the Sub-Mariner (1988) #9
description: Namor’s saga continues amidst Marvel’s mutants! Remember when the Sub-Mariner was a member of Magneto's Brotherhood of Evil Mutants? In case you don’t, we’ve got you covered! Daredevil guest-stars!

title: Wolverine (1988) #9
description: A tale from Wolverine's Department H days! A mercenary group learns their sins are catching up with them, and so is a guy with claws!

title: Silver Surfer (1987) #25
description: Silver Surfer is tricked into becoming an ally of the Skrulls in their battle against the Badoons and Kree.

title: Marvel Comics Presents (1988) #22
description: Contain’s only Panther’s Quest Part 10: Personal Risk. PANTHER’S QUEST PART 10: T’Challa tries to elude the capture of the South African security forces.

title: New Mutants (1983) #76
description: The mansion-less New Mutants go nautical with the X-Terminators!

title: Strikeforce: Morituri (1986) #30
description: The Earth's government is in disarray. The Morituri are in total disgrace. A coup d'etat is moments away.

title: Saga of the Sub-Mariner (1988) #8
description: The Avengers get a taste of Marvel's mightiest malcontents: The Hulk and the Sub-Mariner!

title: Marvel Comics Presents (1988) #21
description: Contains only Panther’s Quest Part 9: Justifiable Action. PANTHER’S QUEST PART 9: T’Challa must overcome a gunshot wound to fight the driver of the truck responsible for the tear gas attack, but more soldiers are on the way.

title: Avengers West Coast (1985) #45
description: Behold! A new incarnation of the Vision is born. How will this new Vision differ from his old self? And will his heightened powers prove too threatening for even his teammates?

title: Wolverine (1988) #8
description: The Hulk's having a bad day, and that means NO ONE'S having a good one! No one except Wolverine!

title: Damage Control (1989) #2
description: Damage Control’s Accountants vs. Doctor Doom! An untraditional smackdown featuring bureaucracy, debt, and financial restitution. Who’s' going to collect? The Fantastic Four guest-star.

title: Sensational She-Hulk (1989) #2
description: Mysterio, usually one of Spider-Man's greatest foes, curiously aims to cast his illusions onto She-Hulk now! Who or what is behind all of this?

title: Marvel Comics Presents (1988) #20
description: Contains only Panther’s Quest Part 8: Hatred under Tears. PANTHER’S QUEST PART 8: T’Challa tries to disable a truck that is attacking the people of the township with tear gas.

title: Marvel Comics Presents (1988) #19
description: Contains Panther’s Quest Part 7: Battered Artifacts and Damage Control in 'Overture'. PANTHER’S QUEST PART 7: T’Challa and Zanti Chikane confront Patrick Slade once and for all!

title: X-Factor (1986) #40
description: Before X-Factor makes their way to Washington, they attend the funeral of Madelyne Prior. En route to Washington, X-Factor is attacked by Nanny and the Orphanmaker. Can they get the children to the Freedom Force in time?

title: Peter Parker, the Spectacular Spider-Man (1976) #150
description: The trial of Joe Robertson starts here! Can Peter manage both heavy courtroom drama and a gang war between Kingpin and the Lobo Brothers?

title: New Mutants (1983) #75
description: Magneto -- Grey King of the Hellfire Club! But Sebastian Shaw smacks this usurper down!

title: Doctor Strange, Sorcerer Supreme (1988) #4
description: A duel with a deadly dragon, alongside the descendants of King Arthur and his knights? Just another day defending the world as the Sorcerer Supreme!

title: Damage Control (1989) #1
description: Who does the world call on in the wake of super hero disasters? Meet the Clean-Up Op that handles the messes no one else wants to touch! Where there’s property damage…there’s Damage Control! Creator Dwayne McDuffie introduces you to the cast of characters responsible for keeping the Marvel Universe clean. It all starts here!

title: Marvel Comics Presents (1988) #18
description: Contains Panther’s Quest Part 6: Naked Exposures & She-Hulk in 'X-Mas Tease'. PANTHER’S QUEST PART 6: The South African Magistrate of Communications, Anton Pretorius, targets T’Challa after learning of his attack on Percy Boraine.

title: The 'Nam (1986) #30
description: The tension on the front line can cause anything to happen…and in "Bunker" that’s exactly what goes down!

title: Wolverine (1988) #7
description: It's Madripoor War Hulk when Joe Fixit comes to town! He's not sure who the players are yet - but Wolverine's decided who HE'S going to play with!

title: Sensational She-Hulk (1989) #1
description: The Sensational She-Hulk shows off her brute strength until she is hyponotized by the Ringmaster! Why does something always have to go wrong at the circus…

title: Strikeforce: Morituri (1986) #29
description: The government is about to be betrayed and overthrown! The Morituri are all either dead, in prison, or working for the enemy! Who remains that can save mankind? The answer is a shocker!

title: Power Pack (1984) #46
description: When Katie's favorite writer is a suspect in a robbery, she goes to the Punisher for justice!

title: Saga of the Sub-Mariner (1988) #7
description: Will Namor claim the Invisible Girl for himself? Not if Reed Richards, Mister Fantastic, has his say!

title: Avengers West Coast (1985) #44
description: In part three of the 'Vision Quest Saga', the team must reconcile with a newly constructed Vision. Will Scarlet Witch find the automaton she loves in Vision 2.0?

title: Marvel Comics Presents (1988) #17
description: Contains only Panther’s Quest Part 5: Reasonable Force. PANTHER’S QUEST PART 5: En route to his hidden glider, T’Challa and Zanti are detained by a pair of soldiers.

title: X-Factor (1986) #39
description: Mr. Sinister and Cyclops' twisted history is revealed as their destructive showdown comes to a head. Can Cyclops' surpass the artificial limitations that Sinister has imposed upon him?

title: Peter Parker, the Spectacular Spider-Man (1976) #149
description: Whle searching for answers about the clones of himself and Gwen Stacy, Spider-Man comes face to face with a new foe known only as Carrion!

title: Uncanny X-Men (1963) #243
description: While Beast and Longshot get people to safety, Jean Grey battles Mr. Sinister on the psychic plane! As Sinister attempts to destroy every single memory that Jean has, Jean must integrate the personalities of both the Phoenix and Madelyne.

title: Iron Man (1968) #241
description: When Tony Stark makes a business trip to Hong Kong, he’s quit to find himself in the middle of a murder investigation. Can Iron Man get to the bottom of this heinous act of violence? Or will his search lead him right in to the clutches of the Mandarin?

title: New Mutants (1983) #74
description: Aftermath to Inferno! What will be left of the X-mansion by the end of this issue?

title: Saga of the Sub-Mariner (1988) #6
description: With his memory restored, Sub-Mariner’s wartime adventures are revisited!

title: Wolverine (1988) #6
description: The Harriers step in as the crime war between Tyger Tiger and General Coy heats up! The only way to tell the good guys from the bad guys is to watch who Wolverine throws down on!

title: Avengers West Coast (1985) #43
description: Scarlet Witch is seething, and her vengeance is mighty; the West Coast Avengers find Vision at a Vigilance base, where he is the latest science experiment of Cameron Brock. Will the Avengers be able to prevent a dissection of their android teammate? Find out in 'To Rescue the Vision'!

title: The Mutant Misadventures of Cloak and Dagger (1988) #4
The 'Nam (1986) #29
description: Peace talks are in progress in Paris, and that means a little R&R's in store for the troops. But even rest and relaxation isn't all it's cracked up to be in the perilous world of the 'NAM!

title: Damage Control (1989) #4
description: Super heroes may be taking names and laying punches in the midst of Acts of Vengeance, but Mrs. Hoag and Albert Cleary have their own war to wage! Will Damage Control fall under new ownership? Not if the loyal office staff has their say!

title: Marvel Comics Presents (1988) #16
description: Contains only Panther’s Quest Part 4: The Man Who Loved Sunrise. PANTHER’S QUEST PART 4: A badly beaten T’Challa struggles to reach his sonar glider with the help of a local miner named Zanti Chikane.

title: Strikeforce: Morituri (1986) #28
description: There's good news for the Morituri - Dr. Tuolema has found a cure to the fatal process that gave them heir powers! But they may never get a chance to try it out, because the latest generation of Morituri are out to kill their predecessors!

title: Marvel Comics Presents (1988) #15
description: Contains only Panther's Quest Part 3: Lost Blood In Copper Dust. PANTHER’S QUEST PART 3: T’Challa and Slade must escape from the clutches of Elmer Gore’s mercenaries.

title: Uncanny X-Men (1963) #242
description: The X-Men defend the Goblyn Queen-who is disguised as Maddie-from X-Factor! Can the two teams discover the queen's ruse in time to stop her?

title: Doctor Strange, Sorcerer Supreme (1988) #3
description: Total Pan-DEMON-ium! Doctor Strange is nearly overwhelmed by the demonic horde, but he's not alone in this fight! Guest-starring the New Defenders!

title: New Mutants (1983) #73
description: While Magik battles S'ym, Cannonball, Sunspot, Rictor, and Warlock engage in a desperate search for her. Will they find Magik before tragedy befalls her? Meanwhile, Mirage, Rusty, and Skids do their best to protect Artie, Leech, and the babies.

title: X-Factor (1986) #38
description: The origin of Madelyne Prior stands revealed! Why does she want revenge on Cyclops? Who orchestrated the events of her life? Plus, Jean Grey is given an ultimatum by the Phoenix itself!

title: Peter Parker, the Spectacular Spider-Man (1976) #148
description: An INFERNO side-story! Demons are on the loose in NYC, and two particularly malevolent spirits have set their sights on Betty Brant and Flash Thompson!

title: Wolverine (1988) #5
description: The Harriers step in as the crime war between Tyger Tiger and General Coy heats up! The only way to tell the good guys from the bad guys is to watch who Wolverine throws down on!

title: The 'Nam (1986) #28
description: Attempting to cut off a shipment of supplies, the men of the 23rd face a fateful choice: will they cross the forbidden border into Cambodia or be killed by the Viet Cong convoy they've ambushed?

title: Damage Control (1989) #3
description: Sensational She-Hulk to the rescue! In the aftermath to Acts of Vengeance, Damage Control calls in back-up from the Jade Giantess. But what begins as a clean-up ends as a riot. Is She-Hulk to blame for the labor union’s discord?

title: Strikeforce: Morituri (1986) #27
description: There are some surprises in store as Doctor Tuolema reviews the entire history of the Morituri Process from its original discovery up to the present. But he'd better finish quickly -- the most recent recipients of the Morituri powers are on their way to kill him!

title: Solo Avengers (1987) #16
description: It's been a long time since Hawkeye and the Black Widow fought as a team. But now, it looks like they may die together unless they can find a way to thwart the plans of A.I.M.! Also featuring a story starring Galactic Avenger, Moondragon!

title: Saga of the Sub-Mariner (1988) #5
description: Here come the Invaders! Sub-Mariner joins the Human Torch, Captain America, Bucky and Toro to take down members of the Third Reich.

title: Marvel Comics Presents (1988) #14
description: Contains only Panther's Quest Part 2: Forgotten Corpses. PANTHER’S QUEST PART 2: During T’Challa’s meeting with Patrick Slade, the two are ambushed by Elmer Gore’s mercenaries.

title: Avengers West Coast (1985) #42
description: Mockingbird makes her triumphant return to the West Coast! But as one teammate appears, another goes missing. Where is the Vision?

title: Peter Parker, the Spectacular Spider-Man (1976) #147
description: The effects of INFERNO hit the world of Spider-Man! Peter's pal Harry Osborn is in grave danger at his chemical plant!

title: Uncanny X-Men (1963) #241
description: As the X-Men begin to undergo demonic transformations of their own, Colossus separates from the group to find his sister Magik.

title: New Mutants (1983) #72
description: Magik has become the Darkchilde! While she battles N'astirh in her new form, the New Mutants are left to fend for themselves against a band of demons. Will Cannonball and his team be able to survive this otherworldly onslaught?

title: X-Factor (1986) #37
description: he Goblyn Queen has the child that Cyclops is searching for. Can the help of the X-Men be enough to usher the child to safety or will it perish in the hands of the queen?

title: The Mutant Misadventures of Cloak and Dagger (1988) #3
Marvel Comics Presents (1988) #13
description: Contains only Panther's Quest: A Rumor of Life. PANTHER’S QUEST PART 1: T’Challa meets with Patrick Slade for information about his mother Ramonda!

title: The Sensational She-Hulk: Ceremony (1989) #2
description: Jennifer and Wyatt head to the Keewazi reservation for their upcoming wedding. But the big day may be ruined by a mystical madman threatening to steal all female magic from the world! Plus, Jennifer and Wyatt undergo a critical shift as a couple.

title: The 'Nam (1986) #27
description: Meet the luckiest soldier the 'Nam's ever seen! He's come through battle after battle without a scratch, and so has his whole unit. But what happens to this lucky guy when his luck finally runs out?

title: Damage Control (1989) #2
description: Gene and Robin, trapped in a shoot-out with The Punisher! Brandishing too many weapons for one person, Punisher invades Damage Control’s office demanding answers. Will Robin Chapel’s silver-tongued sales pitch save the day?

title: Power Pack (1984) #44
description: An Inferno tie-in. It won't be easy for Power Pack to help the New Mutants wrap up Inferno. But that's going to be a breeze compared to facing their parents, now that their folks know about their dual identities!

title: Wolverine (1988) #4
description: Introducing Bloodsport and Roughouse, the odd couple of immortal monsterdom! They're working for Wolverine's enemies - the question is, is ex-New Mutant Karma doing the same?

title: Strikeforce: Morituri (1986) #26
description: The alien Horde has been defeated! But are the aliens who conquered them friendly or Earth's greatest enemies yet? The Morituri Brave wants to know and she wants to know fast -- before she dies like her friends!

title: Solo Avengers (1987) #15
description: Hawkeye has been reunited with his old partner, the Black Widow. And it's a good thing! The avenging archer is going to need all the help he can get when he faces the hordes of A.I.M.!

title: Saga of the Sub-Mariner (1988) #4
description: Namor takes heat from the original Human Torch in their first ever battle!

title: Thor Annual (1966) #14
description: Atlantis Attacks tie-in!

title: Uncanny X-Men (1963) #240
description: The X-Men have found the secret location of the Marauders and head out to do battle! Plus, Rogue and Dazzler face off for Longshot's affection!

title: Power Pack (1984) #43
description: Power Pack's parents have learned their secret identities! But that may be the least of their worries if the Pack can't defeat the Bogeyman and rescue them from the Inferno!

title: Doctor Strange, Sorcerer Supreme (1988) #2
description: All hail Dormammu, Sorcerer Supreme!? The dread demon has taken hold of Strange's body, and only his beloved Clea can save him!

title: New Mutants (1983) #71
description: The New Mutants head to Limbo to take the fight straight to the demons' doorstep! Plus, Magik continues her transformation into the Darkchilde!

title: X-Factor (1986) #36
description: Manhattan has been transformed by demon magic! Inanimate objects have been given life. Subway trains are going off the rails. The Empire State Building is on a rampage. How will the X-Men be able to save anyone when everything is possessed?

title: Peter Parker, the Spectacular Spider-Man (1976) #146
description: The effects of INFERNO hit the world of Spider-Man! Peter's pal Harry Osborn is in grave danger at his chemical plant!

title: The 'Nam (1986) #26
description: Over the past couple of years, we've seen a lot of characters finish their tours of duty and leave the 'Nam. But what happened to them next? You'll find out as we check up on Ed, Top, Rob, and all the rest in this special home-front issue!

title: Damage Control (1989) #1
description: An Acts of Vengeance crossover! John, Gene, and Bart are trapped in the maximum security wing of The Vault. Meanwhile, Damage Control is sold to a multi-national corporation. And that's the good news!

title: Peter Parker, the Spectacular Spider-Man Annual (1979) #9
Strikeforce: Morituri (1986) #25
description: The Morituri welcome three new members. But the welcome may be very short-lived, because the government's secret anti-Morituri force is planning to make instant martyrs of the whole Strikeforce: Morituri team!

title: Solo Avengers (1987) #14
description: When the Black Widow finds herself about to be snuffed by A.I.M., it's Hawkeye to the rescue!

title: Squadron Supreme: Death of a Universe (1989)
Daredevil Annual (1967) #5
description: ATLANTIS ATTACKS! Talk about your free-for-all fights! Dr. Tyrone— you know him as Tyrannus— is out to destroy Ghaur's plan. He's got a good chance in succeeding, because he's got Spider-Man under his control!

title: Saga of the Sub-Mariner (1988) #3
description: Namor takes New York! Recounting the Sub-Mariner’s Big Apple adventure from Marvel Mystery #1-4!

title: X-Factor Annual (1986) #4
description: Two FBI agents arrive in New York to discover what really happened during INFERNO. After X-Factor undergoes a round of questioning the team enlists the help of Reed Richards to help with their cover story.

title: X-Factor Annual (1986) #4
description: Two FBI agents arrive in New York to discover what really happened during INFERNO. After X-Factor undergoes a round of questioning the team enlists the help of Reed Richards to help with their cover story.

title: Daredevil Annual (1967) #5
description: ATLANTIS ATTACKS! Talk about your free-for-all fights! Dr. Tyrone— you know him as Tyrannus— is out to destroy Ghaur's plan. He's got a good chance in succeeding, because he's got Spider-Man under his control!

title: Wolverine (1988) #3
description: Wolverine's not himself - in fact, he's possessed by the Muramasa Sword! The beast within the blade has targeted Jessica Drew, a.k.a. Spider-Woman, for sacrifice; only her best friend and a longtime enemy can save her!

title: X-Factor (1986) #35
description: Cyclops' son is in danger of demon-abduction and so, with the help of Jean Grey, he sets out to rescue the boy. But with a demon horde bearing down on them, will the mutant duo be able to retrieve the child?

title: Peter Parker, the Spectacular Spider-Man (1976) #145
description: Spidey's clash with Boomerang on the West Coast continues, with a finale you won't believe! But he'd better get back to NYC fast, because gang wars are flaring up, and the Wolf Brothers are challenging the Kingpin!

title: Uncanny X-Men (1963) #239
description: Jean Grey is alive! One of her teammates has known about this for quite some time, and Storm isn't too happy about it. Meanwhile, tensions near their breaking point between Psylocke and Rogue. Fists will fly!

title: The Mutant Misadventures of Cloak and Dagger (1988) #2
Strikeforce: Morituri (1986) #24
description: As if mankind's war against the alien Horde wasn't bad enough, now the Morituri force must face the appearance of two new alien races! And to make matters worse, one of those aliens promises to make the Morituri more dangerous to mankind than the Horde!

title: Saga of the Sub-Mariner (1988) #2
description: A young Sub-Mariner has his first brush with surface-dwellers!

title: Wolverine (1988) #2
description: A cursed sword is seeking a kindred spirit, and a hero has already fallen prey to its evil! Is Wolverine next? Guest-starring the Silver Samurai!

title: The 'Nam (1986) #25
description: Andy Clark and Jim Rubino are in Khe Sanh to get help for Rubino's wounded leg. But Khe Sanh is the target for one of the first strikes in the Tet Offensive! Can they rescue an ancient city from the North Vietnamese onslaught?

title: Uncanny X-Men (1963) #238
description: Madelyne Pryor harnesses the Phoenix Force, and the X-Men siege the Magistrate citadel!

title: Doctor Strange, Sorcerer Supreme (1988) #1
description: Doctor Strange is dead! Or so the world believes, as the work of a Sorcerer Supreme is never done! Strange’s newest task is also his most dire: defeat the dread DORMAMMU!

title: X-Factor (1986) #34
description: Angel, now the winged beast known as Death, makes his way to Cameron Hodge's hideout on a mission to rescue his girlfriend Candy Southern. But Hodge has other plans for the flying mutant...

title: Peter Parker, the Spectacular Spider-Man (1976) #144
description: Peter's business trip to San Diego is cut short when the villainous Boomerang makes an explosive entrance! Fists fly and webs sling in this showdown at Silicon Beach!

title: Uncanny X-Men (1963) #237
description: Rogue and Logan have lost their powers-can they survive long enough for the X-Men to make it to Genosha?

title: Peter Parker, the Spectacular Spider-Man Annual (1979) #8
description: First appearance of the Young Gods! The High Evolutionary apprehends Gwen Stacy’s clone in an attempt to harness the secret of cloning.

title: The 'Nam (1986) #24
description: North Vietnam launches the Tet Offensive! This seems like the beginning of the end for the United States!

title: Strikeforce: Morituri (1986) #23
description: Hardcase became a Morituri in a search for honor and glory. But when he finally finds them, he discovers that honor and glory are actually two very different things!

title: Saga of the Sub-Mariner (1988) #1
description: Roy and Dann Thomas present the Saga of the Sub-Mariner, Prince of Atlantis! The origin of Namor, retold in full!

title: Nick Fury Vs. S.H.I.E.L.D. (1988) #6
description: In this epic conclusion, Nick persuades Madame Hydra to lead him to the source of the conspiracy… S.H.I.E.L.D’S Satellite!

title: Wolverine (1988) #1
description: Welcome to Madripoor, the best place to find trouble and lose yourself in it! It's a key piece of Wolverine's past, and death awaits him there in #1 of his first ongoing series!

title: Uncanny X-Men (1963) #236
description: The X-Men uncover the truth of Genegineer David Moreau's mutate process, and Rogue and Wolverine attempt to escape Genoshan prison!

title: X-Factor (1986) #33
description: The Alliance of Evil has an anti-mutant message that it wants the world to hear, in the form of ultimate destruction! But Jean Grey and Iceman have a better idea and it involves stopping the Alliance in their tracks!

title: Peter Parker, the Spectacular Spider-Man (1976) #143
description: The wall-crawler senses that his sometimes-ally, sometimes-enemy Punisher is in grave danger, and travels to Dallas to help! But when he arrives, he's faced with a mind-controlled Frank Castle - out for spider-blood!

title: West Coast Avengers Annual (1986) #3
description: The WCA split up for a two-pronged assault on the High Evolutionary! Hawkeye, Wonder Man, Vision, and the Scarlet Witch may have experience, and Mockingbird, Moon Knight, and Tigra may be relentless and vicious, but can either team stand against the Evolutionary's incredible power?

title: Uncanny X-Men (1963) #235
description: The Genoshan Press Gang goes to Australia to retrieve a former Genoshan nurse whose mutant gene has awoken. Who will be ensnared in their net along the way?

title: Nick Fury Vs. S.H.I.E.L.D. (1988) #5
description: In the heart of the Himalayas, Nick and Madame Hydra delve deeper into the mystery of the Delta Equation and the corruption that's been eating away at S.H.I.E.L.D.!

title: Power Pack (1984) #42
description: As the Inferno storyline gets under way, the Bogeyman returns from Limbo... as a real Bogeyman! When he takes revenge on Power Pack in front of the kids' parents, it could blow their secret identities forever!

title: Nick Fury Vs. S.H.I.E.L.D. (1988) #5
description: In the heart of the Himalayas, Nick and Madame Hydra delve deeper into the mystery of the Delta Equation and the corruption that's been eating away at S.H.I.E.L.D.!

title: Peter Parker, the Spectacular Spider-Man (1976) #142
description: Spider-Man chases Tombstone all the way to Atlanta, where the final showdown happens at last! Can Peter avenge his friend Joe?

title: Nick Fury Vs. S.H.I.E.L.D. (1988) #4
description: The scene shifts to Hong Kong as Nick and his allies travel overseas to learn more about the corruption that's eaten away at S.H.I.E.L.D.! Madame Hydra's on hand, too ... but is she friend or foe?

title: Strikeforce: Morituri (1986) #21
description: When a soldier-turned-slave falls in love with the Morituri's Toxin, he may have no choice but to undergo the deadly Morituri process himself!

title: The 'Nam (1986) #22
description: As the Tet Offensive draws nearer, the men of the 23rd celebrate Thanksgiving in the field. But what they don't realize is that they're giving the enemy something to be thankful about, too!

title: Silver Surfer (1987) #14
description: Silver Surfer vs. Silver Surfer? One’s an imposter, one’s the real deal. And by the end of this issue, only one will stand triumphant!

title: Peter Parker, the Spectacular Spider-Man (1976) #141
description: Spidey continues his search for Tombstone, but he soon discovers he's not alone in his search. Someone else has Tombstone in his sights, and he's not the type to show mercy! Watch out, Tombstone, the Punisher is on your trail!

title: Nick Fury Vs. S.H.I.E.L.D. (1988) #3
description: To aid in his battle against S.H.I.E.L.D., Fury recruits some unlikely allies — Tony Stark, an accountant, and one of the greatest villainesses in the world!

title: The 'Nam (1986) #21
description: A wounded medic, Andy Clark, is awarded a Purple Heart. But it is a medal he believes others need more than he does! But complicating his desire to give the medal to those who deserve it is girl trouble -- South Vietnamese style!

title: The Punisher (1987) #10
description: The Punisher and Daredevil may be tracking the same madman, but their different approaches in handling a murderer make them enemies in combat! Justice is dished out to the Punisher- will Frank Castle let DD have the final say?

title: Silver Surfer (1987) #13
description: Ronan the Accuser comes to Nenora’s aid after a band of soldiers attempt mutiny. How much longer can the Skrull imposter maintain her ruse? Surfer finds a moment to mourn the death of Mantis, but is invigorated by a new mission- finding her son!

title: Peter Parker, the Spectacular Spider-Man (1976) #140
description: Joe Robertson is bedridden in the hospital, gravely injured in his encounter with Tombstone. Shaken to his core, Peter Parker embarks on a solemn misson: find Tombstone and make him answer to justice, at any cost!

title: Iron Man (1968) #232
description: It's Tony Stark's worst nightmare! In a fevered dream-like state, Iron Man faces what he fears the most: his technology running rampant -- causing world war, death and destruction -- and it's all his fault! Will Tony turn back to the bottle or let the technology take control? See Iron Man vs. his greatest enemy: himself!

title: Strikeforce: Morituri (1986) #20
description: When the new Morituri find the late Vyking's tape recorder and autobiography, the stage is set for a landmark tale in the annals of the Morituri. All the loose ends surrounding the old Morituri are tied up, as the new generation prepares to take over - even though the fledgling heroes know it will cost them their lives!

title: Nick Fury Vs. S.H.I.E.L.D. (1988) #2
description: Nick Fury goes “Into the Depths” alongside Black Knight, Dr. Druid, She-Hulk, and Thor!

title: Peter Parker, the Spectacular Spider-Man (1976) #139
description: The origins of the sinister villain Tombstone are revealed!

title: Iron Man (1968) #231
description: Iron Man, no more! With Tony Stark wounded and unable to don his armor, he decides to retire the Iron Man for good! But when Firepower goes rogue and attacks Stark Enterprises, Tony may have to don a new set of armor to stop him! Armor Wars concludes as Iron Man becomes a hero once more!

title: Strikeforce: Morituri (1986) #19
description: Separated from the rest of the team, the last of the first generation Morituri has a baby! But can she singlehandedly defend her child from the alien Horde? And even if she does, can she survive the effects of her own powers?

title: Nick Fury Vs. S.H.I.E.L.D. (1988) #1
description: For years, Nick Fury has led S.H.I.E.L.D. But the spy network has become corrupt and Fury's got to go underground to fight it... even though it means fighting— and killing— some of his closest friends as well!

title: Peter Parker, the Spectacular Spider-Man (1976) #138
description: Spider-Man is finally able to chase down Tarantula. And it looks like this case is all webbed up! But unbeknownst to the wall-crawler, Tarantula has a shocking new ally - Captain America!

title: Silver Surfer (1987) #11
description: Silver Surfer and Nova team-up! Will these two cosmic wanderers ever find The Contemplator? Nenora has usurped control over the Kree following the Supreme Intelligence’s meltdown. Plus, attack of the space pirates!

title: Iron Man (1968) #230
description: Unwilling to ignore Iron Man's crimes any longer, the government tasks the armored warrior, Firepower, to take down the former hero! And Firepower just might win! As Jim Rhodes looks on helplessly, Tony Stark takes the beating of his life! Is this the end of Iron Man?

title: Strikeforce: Morituri (1986) #18
description: It's one thing to know that your super powers will kill you someday. But as the Morituri's Scatterbrain learns, it's another thing entirely to have death stare you in the face!

title: Iron Man (1968) #229
description: Iron Man is kicked out of the Avengers! When Tony Stark's quest to reclaim his technology takes him to Siberia, the Crimson Dynamo and the Titanium Man wait to defeat him once and for all! See Stark unveil a new all-black armor for a special mission that could leave Iron Man a murderer!

title: Peter Parker, the Spectacular Spider-Man (1976) #137
description: There's a new Tarantula in town, and he's on a mission to take out any political refugee he can find!

title: Marvel Fanfare (1982) #37
description: Here be Dragons! The Warriors Three are caught up in a dreamscape illusion while trying to recover a missing Asgardian! And Loki’s to blame!

title: Silver Surfer (1987) #10
description: The Elders pay for their insurrection, and Galactus feasts. On Kree-Lar, infighting between Skrulls establishes the leadership of an entire alien race. Death comes for Galactus. Is it coming for all of Zenn-La too?

title: Strikeforce: Morituri (1986) #17
description: Is the government betraying the Morituri heroes they created? Strikeforce: Morituri discovers that the truth behind the government's stonewalling is even more devastating! Not only is the government secretly creating a new Morituri base, they plan to populate it with a new generation of Morituri warriors! Trouble is, this new Morituri-making process "Breeds Monsters"!

title: X-Terminators (1988) #4
description: The X-Terminators, Artie, and Leech are being held prisoner by N'astirh as demons pour into Manhattan in full force. Can the X-Terminators escape in time to stave off the demonic horde?

title: Solo Avengers (1987) #5
description: It's an archery duel to the death between Hawkeye and Trick Shot! Silver Sable's trying to save Hawkeye from the duel, because she knows that Trick Shot has made sure there's no way Hawkeye can win!

title: Web of Spider-Man (1985) #37
description: A serial slasher is targeting young models in Manhattan -- can Spider-Man put a stop to it before Mary Jane's best friend becomes his next victim?

title: Uncanny X-Men (1963) #227
description: The X-Men must fight their way through a demonic distortion of the Vietnam War in order to reach their final showdown with the Adversary! Colossus returns to help his former teammates, but will that be enough?

title: Silver Surfer (1987) #9
description: The Elders of the Universe need all the Infinity Gems for their takedown of Galactus- too bad the Soul Gem is safe in Surfer’s possession! Will Norrin relinquish the Soul Gem for the freedom of Shalla Bal and Mantis? Nova guest-stars!

title: X-Factor (1986) #26
description: X-Factor finally receives a hero’s welcome after saving the entire city from Apocalypse’s Horsemen.

title: New Mutants (1983) #61
description: The New Mutants cope with the loss of Doug Ramsey. Magneto lashes out at his students for their carelessness, and Illyana responds in kind for his lack of concern. But with the X-Men gone too, is it up to the New Mutants to save the world now?

title: Iron Man (1968) #228
description: Iron Man vs. the Captain! Tony Stark vs. Steve Rogers! More determined than ever to reclaim his technology, Iron Man -- with help from Jim Rhodes -- breaks into the Vault and disarms the Guardsmen, causing a mass super villain breakout! Surely Stark wouldn't fight his oldest friend just to meet his own goals?

title: Peter Parker, the Spectacular Spider-Man (1976) #136
description: Spidey's final showdown with Sin Eater!

title: Strikeforce: Morituri (1986) #16
description: Where would you expect to find a showdown between Morituri and their alien foes, the Horde? Would you believe an Old West ghost town?

title: X-Terminators (1988) #3
description: The X-Terminators must battle their way through a veritable legion of demons to find the location of Artie, Leech, and Taki.

title: New Mutants (1983) #60
description: With the Animator's Animates and Cameron Hodge's army attacking them on all fronts, the island of Paradise may be the final battleground for one New Mutant!

title: Iron Man (1968) #227
description: Justin Hammer has access to Tony Stark's technology, and Iron Man won't stand for it! But Tony is losing allies right and left -- with the police, S.H.I.E.L.D. and the Avengers all determined to stop him! When Iron Man battles the government-sponsored Mandroids, the Captain (Steve Rogers, the once and future Captain America) steps in to talk some sense into Stark!

title: Silver Surfer (1987) #8
description: Absorbed into the hive mind of the Supreme Intelligence, Silver Surfer sees a reality never destined to be. Love, companionship, the blissfulness of peace- will Norrin Radd ever experience these things again? Back on Zenn-La, Shalla Bal’s in dire straits…and Mantis is nowhere to be found!

title: Peter Parker, the Spectacular Spider-Man (1976) #135
description: ELECTRO HAS WON! Even if Spider-Man survives, how can he beat a foe that knows exactly how to beat HIM?

title: Uncanny X-Men (1963) #226
description: With each team holding members of the other team captive, the X-Men and the Freedom Force are at an uneasy stalemate. But when the Adversary's chaos begins tearing Dallas asunder, the two teams must cooperate to save the innocent-and themselves!

title: Power Pack (1984) #35
description: FALL OF THE MUTANTS tie-in! Power Pack is attacked by the Horsemen of Apocalypse! Guest-starring X-Factor!

title: Strikeforce: Morituri (1986) #15
description: They were transformed into Earth's greatest heroes - knowing that they would die within twelve months as a fatal side-effect. Now one of the Morituri, Radian, has a chance to find a cure for the terminal consequences. But his quest for that cure may cut the lives of hiss teammates even shorter when he leads them into a trap set by a band of super-powered alien Hordians!

title: X-Terminators (1988) #2
description: Rusty, Skids, Boom-Boom, Rictor and Taki hatch a daring plan to rescue Artie and Leech from N'astirh, demon of Limbo. But they can't do it without X-Factor's help. Will the mutant superheroes answer the call?

title: Avengers Annual (1967) #17
description: It's the wild wrap-up of the Evolutionary War! But who's going to fight it, considering the Avengers have disbanded?

title: Iron Man (1968) #226
description: Iron Man goes rogue, so Tony Stark fires him! But wait, aren't they the same person? As Armor Wars continues, Iron Man reclaims Stark's technology in a deadly battle with the villainous Raiders -- but when he attacks scientist and hero Stingray, public opinion of the Golden Avenger falls lower than ever! How will Stark get out of this one?

title: Silver Surfer (1987) #7
description: Kree forces invade the peaceful planet of Zenn-La. Can Surfer, Mantis and Shalla Bal prevent the coming onslaught? Surfer must reconcile his feelings for Mantis, all while striking an agreement with the Kree’s Supreme Intelligence!

title: New Mutants (1983) #59
description: In order to save Bird-Brain and his fellow Animates from the Animator, the New Mutants must take part in his cruel tests! Will the team make it off the Animator's island?

title: Uncanny X-Men (1963) #225
description: While the X-Men search for Storm in Dallas, the government-sanctioned Freedom Force attempt to arrest them. The X-Men take refuge in Forge's penthouse...but Destiny predicts that by dawn, anyone in that building will be dead!

title: Marvel Fanfare (1982) #36
description: A tale of the Warriors Three! Fandral the Dashing embarks on a Homeric quest told in the Mighty Marvel Manner! And he still finds time to woo many a maiden!

title: X-Factor (1986) #24
description: Will Apocalypse finally make X-Factor join his side?

title: Peter Parker, the Spectacular Spider-Man (1976) #134
description: The origin of the Sin Eater is revealed! And the unthinkable happens -- Spider-Man falls in battle!

title: Marvel Age Annual (1985) #4
description: Madripoor frequenter Wolverine shares his knowledge on the world’s seediest port town with X-Factor and the New Mutants! Speedball learns that the villain Crooked Face has it out for his family! The Hulk may step into the role as Damage Control’s new spokesperson!

title: Fantastic Four Annual (1963) #21
description: Crystal of the Inhumans…apprehended by her own family! The High Evolutionary “greets” the FF in Attilan, while Crystal has a tense one-on-one with King Black Bolt!

title: Amazing Spider-Man Annual (1964) #22
description: Meet the hottest new hero in the Marvel Universe - Speedball, the Masked Marvel! He's got to help Spider-Man and Daredevil stop the Kingpin's implacable drive to increase the supply of illegal drugs in New York City! Plus: a special fact-filled featured on Speedball!

title: The Punisher Annual (1988) #1
description: Look out! Here come the High Evolutionary's Eliminators! They're under orders to destroy all the drug fields in South America - and they've got more than enough power to do it! You'd think the Punisher would be overjoyed! But these "allies" could be more dangerous than even his greatest enemy! The Punisher must decide - should he join them, or try to stop them! Plus: More secrets of the High Evolutionary are revealed!

title: Silver Surfer Annual (1988) #1
description: It’s Silver Surfer Vs. the ever-shifting Super Skrull in this Evolutionary Wars crossover issue!

title: Web of Spider-Man Annual (1985) #4
description: Peter Parker went to Miami expecting to do a run-of-the-mill signing for his new book. But when the High Evolutionary strikes, Spidey must join forces with the misshapen Man-Thing and Miami's newest super hero, Poison, to protect not only the universe but all of the alternate universes as well!

title: X-Factor Annual (1986) #3
description: Members of X-Force all receive the same distress call! Jean decides to lead the investigation.

title: X-Men Annual (1970) #12
description: The Savage Land has been decimated! The X-Men and High Evolutionary have a huge project ahead of them…but of course Garrok has to make things even more difficult, right?

title: Strikeforce: Morituri (1986) #14

description: SOMEONE HAS MURDERED FORBUSH MAN! Could someone be targeting all of Marvel’s funniest characters for death? That’s what Deadpool thinks, and now he’s gotta act before someone bumps off SQUIRREL GIRL, ROCKET RACCOON, GROOT, ANT-MAN, HOWARD THE DUCK and THE PUNISHER! (Like we said, the funny characters.) Good thing Deadpool is renowned for his investigative skills!

title: Uncanny Inhumans (2015) #12 (Tolibao Death of X Variant)
Doctor Strange (2015) #10 (Broccardo Death of X Variant)
Uncanny Inhumans (2015) #12
description: CIVIL WAR II TIE-IN! With the Inhumans taking on the Invincible Iron Man, Maximus the Mad enters into the fray to make matters worse!

title: Silk (2015) #11
description: Finally, the reveal of SPECTRO! Who is this ghostly figure and what does he have to do with SILK?!

title: A Year of Marvels: The Incredible (2016) #3
description: Sam Alexander’s finding it hard to cope with the fact that his dad is M.I.A. in the far reaches of space. Luckily, this Father’s Day, Nova’s got the chance to help former New Warrior Midnight’s Fire put his family back together. But when Iron Man shows up to inform his young teammate he’s backing the wrong horse, will Nova cool his jets? Celebrating the Fourth of July is complicated enough for a patriotic symbol turned soviet assassin, but then Hydra agents had to go and rob the Winter Soldier’s secret storage locker. Who sent them? What do they want? Bucky doesn’t care — he just wants his #$%& back.

title: Spidey (2015) #9
description: Kraven the Hunter has his target set on his most formidable foe...high school teen, Peter Parker? What the what?! Meanwhile, Peter’s on his own hunt…for the perfect birthday gift for Aunt May!

title: Marvel Tsum Tsum (2016) #1
description: In case you’ve been living under a rock, Tsum Tsums are HUGE! Well, not LITERALLY (they’re actually pretty tiny) but these seemingly cute and cuddly creatures are sweeping the globe! So what happens when these pint-sized piles of fur find their way into the Marvel Universe? After a crate of them falls to Earth en route to THE COLLECTOR, one small group of Brooklyn teenagers will find out! Featuring all of your favorite Marvel heroes and villains, this is sure to be TSUM-thing you won’t want to miss!

title: Civil War II: Kingpin (2016) #2
description: Despite the heroes’ new future-seeing ally, the crime business is treating Wilson Fisk VERY well. So well, in fact, that his jealous competitors are MURDERING the Kingpin’s men. And to make matters worse, the linchpin of Fisk’s operation — an inhuman with the uncanny ability to stay incognito — is getting ill. Can the Kingpin find a way to keep his business afloat or is his time on top finally finished?

title: Doctor Strange (2015) #10
description: THE THRILLING CONCLUSION OF “LAST DAYS OF MAGIC”! The Sorcerer Supreme must learn some new tricks and utilize new weapons if he’s to defeat the Empirikul! Witness the status quo shift of the Sorcerer Supreme!

title: Marvel Universe Avengers: Ultron Revolution (2016) #2
description: ULTRON’S ULTIMATE SOLUTION! Ultron’s got the perfect plan for an imperfect humanity: Replace all humans with robots! The first replacements on the list? THE AVENGERS! But can the Avengers overcome their own weaknesses to defeat their flawless impostors?

title: The Punisher (2016) #4 (Zdarsky Black Panther Variant Variant)
Vote Loki (2016) #3
description: When you’re running for president of the United States, it’s essential to take time to mingle with your constituents, and Loki’s got the American people eating out of the palm of his hand. The campaign trail isn’t all shaking hands and kissing babies, though — when a destabilizing crisis hits Latveria, Loki seizes the opportunity to prove his presidential mettle (and simultaneously leave his competitors in the dust). A country’s in turmoil, and the God of Mischief seems to be on top of the world. It’s almost like he planned it. But surely he wouldn’t cause a national catastrophe for a little good press, would he?

title: Deadpool (2015) #16
description: CIVIL WAR II TIE-IN! In Deadpool #16, we finally find out how Deadpool became so popular!

title: Invincible Iron Man (2015) #12
description: A heartbreaking chapter in the history of Iron Man as the events of CIVIL WAR II come crashing down around him. Plus, what exactly is Doctor Doom up to in the time of all-out CIVIL WAR?

title: Deadpool V Gambit (2016) #3
description: The con’s gone south, fast, which leads to…a cookout? Yep – if you wanna see Wade and Remy slinging meat, this book’s for you! Plus…we take a deep dive into the life of…The Scrambler?

title: The Punisher (2016) #4
description: MADNESS AHEAD, TROUBLE BEHIND! The PUNISHER tracks the psychopathic FACE and his madness-inducing drug EMC to a derelict insane asylum! But Punisher’s got his own tail: DEA agents, and Face…DRIVING A TANK. The little girl in the Punisher’s passenger seat might be safer on the side of the road!

title: Uncanny X-Men (2016) #11
description: NEW STORY ARC STARTS NOW! Someone is weaponizing mutants and turning them loose on the enemies of mutantkind…which happens to coincide with the X-Men’s discovery that MAGNETO has not been altogether forthcoming about the means he’s been employing to protect the mutant race. Eager to know exactly what Magneto’s been up to, the X-Men investigate…starting with the all-new, all-different HELLFIRE CLUB!

title: New Avengers (2015) #14
description: All-action issue! Will the New Revengers take down A.I.M. — or will S.H.I.E.L.D. get there first? And will anyone be left to stop W.H.I.S.P.E.R. before it’s too late? Featuring White Tiger vs. White Tiger — the rematch! And more twists and turns than a plate of spaghetti, True Believer!

title: Civil War II: Choosing Sides (2016) #3 (Mckelvie Variant)
X-23: The Complete Collection Vol. 1 (Trade Paperback)
description: The origin of X-23! Cloned from Wolverine’s cells and raised to be the perfect killer, young Laura Kinney never knew a life free from the harsh masters at the Facility. But now she’s broken loose at last and must forge her own path in the world! Free of her chains and determined to live, Laura will write the next chapter of her story herself. But can X-23 escape her training and her instincts, or will the gallons of blood spilled in her violent past drag her down? And can she truly begin a new life until she faces the man whose shadow has loomed over her for years? Enter: The Wolverine! Collecting X-23 (2005) #1-6, X-23: TARGET X #1-6, CAPTAIN UNIVERSE/X-23, X-23 (2010) ONE-SHOT and #1-3, and material from X-MEN: TO SERVE AND PROTECT #2.

title: All-New, All-Different Avengers (2015) #12
description: In chains, held captive millions of light-years from home, the Avengers are without salvation and without hope — unless they’re willing to make some hard choices. Plus: More on the new Wasp!

title: True Believers: Amazing Spider-Man - The Dark Kingdom (2016) #1
Black Panther (2016) #4
description: “A NATION UNDER OUR FEET,” the first arc of the new hit BLACK PANTHER series, comes to a startling conclusion! Suicide bombers terrorize the people of Wakanda, further eroding any last bits of goodwill towards the royal family…T’Challa struggles to unite his citizens, who are choosing to side with Zenzi and The People in growing numbers…A familiar villain reveals his part in T’Challa’s current ruination…and it’s not who you think!

title: X-Men '92 (2016) #5
description: An X-TRA special and X-TREME one-off tale featuring the best romance the ’90s can offer! Scott Summers and Jean Grey want nothing more than a quiet, romantic getaway. But time for “romance” and “quiet” doesn’t exist when you’re an X-Man! Something Sinister this way comes for our two lovebirds!!!

title: The Totally Awesome Hulk (2015) #9
description: CIVIL WAR II TIE-IN! AMADEUS CHO has lost someone very close to him. Now he’s mad. VERY MAD. No one would like him when he’s very mad. Introducing new series artist, the critically acclaimed Mike del Mundo!

title: Moon Girl and Devil Dinosaur (2015) #9
description: The epic battle everyone’s been waiting for: MOON GIRL VERSUS KID KREE! Kid Kree makes his big move to capture Moon Girl and Devil Dino! Meanwhile, Lunella makes a MAJOR discovery about her new abilities!

title: Guardians of The Galaxy Classic: In The Year 3000 Vol. 1 (Trade Paperback)
description: Continue exploring the Marvel Universe of the 31st Century with the original Guardians of the Galaxy! But will the team survive a Major blow when Vance Astro walks out? COLLECTING: GUARDIANS OF THE GALAXY (1990) #30-39, ANNUAL #3; MATERIAL FROM MARVEL COMICS PRESENTS #134.

title: Uncanny Avengers (2015) #11 (Takeda Death of X Variant)

Ruth and Chris Gage, the talented writing duo from Marvel’s Daredevil on Netflix, bring you a Captain Marvel Civil War story you will never forget!

title: Uncanny Avengers (2015) #11
description: The Uncanny Avengers fight a war on two fronts as they discover they can’t trust someone close. Not everyone is happy to see that Hank Pym has returned. And…a fateful decision will change the life of one Avenger forever.

description: “APOCALYPSE WARS” CONCLUSION! Trapped a thousand years in the future on a world ruled by the genocidal tyrant Apocalypse, the X-Men are literally mutantkind’s last hope! With the fate of the next generation of mutants hanging in the balance, the X-Men square off against Apocalypse and his Horsemen one last time. But with some of their own in Apocalypse’s ranks, how can the X-Men hope to win the day? In what’s sure to be a battle for the ages, one thing is certain: not all of the X-Men will emerge unscathed!

Plus: the Orb, the Infinity Stones, Knowhere, Xandar, Bereet, Cosmo…and Howard the Duck! Relive the thrills of Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy, and continue building your indispensable library of Cinematic Universe reference books!

title: Black Panther (2016) #2 (Stelfreeze 3rd Printing Black and White Variant)
The Amazing Spider-Man (2015) #1.6
description: Spider-Man and the Santerians team up to fight a foe that will shake what faith they have!

title: True Believers: Mighty Thor - The Strongest Viking There Is (2016) #1
Uncanny Avengers (2015) #11 (Sternako Captain America Black and White Variant)
Mockingbird (2016) #5
description: MOCKINGBIRD has to fight her way through a S.H.I.E.L.D. medical clinic, learning some awkward private medical information about her super hero colleagues in the process. Nagging questions regarding ping pong balls and zombie levitation will be answered! And Bobbi will punch a whole lot of dead old people.

title: Captain America: Steve Rogers (2016) #3
description: Hydra vs. Hydra! The Red Skull vs. Zemo, with Captain America caught in the crossfire. The trial of Maria Hill begins.

title: Extraordinary X-Men (2015) #12 (Yu Death of X Variant)
International Iron Man (2016) #5
description: As Iron Man takes center stage in one of the biggest events in Marvel history, Tony is finally faced with the true identity of his parents. This is a cannot-miss issue in the life of Tony Stark.

title: The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl (2015) #10
description: Mole Man has fallen in love with Squirrel Girl, and he’s holding the world hostage until she goes on a date with him! MOLE MEN, am I right?? Watch as Squirrel Girl gains the help of an unlikely ally! Thrill as two people kiss! BUT WHICH TWO?? You’ll have to buy the issue to find out, so all I’ll say right now is this: IN THIS ISSUE THERE IS A NON-ZERO CHANCE FOR EVERY MARVEL SHIP TO BECOME CANON!! “Ship” is short for “relationship,” in case you thought I was talking about, like, Galactus’ “Star Sphere” or Mr. Fantastic’s “Fantasticship” or whatever. Anyway, enjoy!!

title: Black Panther (2016) #4 (Yardin Death of X Variant)
Drax (2015) #9
description: BONFIRE OF THE BOUNTY HUNTERS Unhinged mercenary KILLER THRILL is closing the gap between her and DRAX…by filling it with BODIES! Plus she’s got her half-weird hands on Drax’s paperweight! That was a GIFT from the KIDS!!! (…Also it’s a FIN FANG FOOM EGG.) You gotta break a few eggs to make an omelet…OF FIRE!

title: Civil War II: Choosing Sides (2016) #3
description: The battle is heating up, but nothing’s hotter than the limelight! When the media starts muckraking, how far will heroes go to stay out of the public eye? Featuring Nick Fury, Kate Bishop, and jolly J. Jonah Jameson himself!

title: Star Wars: The Force Awakens Adaptation (2016) #2 (Samnee Variant)
Marvel Universe Ultimate Spider-Man Vs. the Sinister Six (2016) #1
description: HYDRA ATTACKS! With the events of SPIDER-VERSE and CONTEST OF CHAMPIONS behind him, things are looking up for Peter Parker! S.H.I.E.L.D. leader + respected hero + good standing with family = happy Spider-Man! What could go wrong? How about Doc Ock + Arnim Zola + Hydra?!

title: Howard the Duck (2015) #9
description: Howard is back in NEW YORK CITY! And on his strangest case yet: A missing person! His client? The missing person! WHAAA—? Join us as Howard encounters aliens, Brooklyn and network television with a SPECIAL GUEST STAR so SHOCKING that I am STILL SHOCKED that we’re ALLOWED TO DO THIS. SERIOUSLY.

title: Machine Man by Kirby & Ditko: The Complete Collection (Trade Paperback)
description: A military machine with a soul, a thinking computer in the form of a man, X-51 is the Machine Man! Abel Stack gave a government-created robot a human face, nurturing the man inside the machine and calling him son. But Stack's death left that son, Aaron, alone and running for his life. The military wants to strip him apart, mankind doesn't understand him - but in exploits crafted by two of the medium's greatest talents, he'll still redefine humanity. Few comic books were lucky enough to be graced by the work of Jack Kirby and Steve Ditko. COLLECTING: Machine Man (1978) #1-19; Incredible Hulk (1968) #235-237; Marvel Comics Presents #10.

title: CIVIL WAR II: ULYSSES INFINITE COMIC (2016) #3
description: Committed to comprehending his Inhuman ability to see the future, Ulysses begins training within Karnak’s Tower—but has he made the right choice? Struck with a grisly vision, Ulysses must again come to terms with the magnitude of his power... and the limitations!

title: Mighty Thor (2015) #9
description: Marvel’s most corrupt corporations are up to something sinister, but Thor and S.H.I.E.L.D. Agent Roz Solomon are determined to stop them. At the heart of the ultimate white-collar crime? None other than the Silver Samurai and the Exterminatrix! OH! And it turns out millions of lives depend on the God of Thunder saving Roxxon’s own evil executive Dario Agger.

title: Captain America: Steve Rogers (2016) #3 (Wada Death of X Variant)
Haunted Mansion (2016) #5
description:
Danny is on the run from the Captain! Good thing they’re already in a graveyard — since Danny isn’t getting out alive! Ghosts, ghouls and a surprise to scare you out of your skin — you won’t want to miss the thrilling conclusion to the fan-favorite Disney Kingdoms miniseries!
Elements based on Haunted Mansion © Disney

title: All-New, All-Different Avengers (2015) #12 (Nakayama Death of X Variant)
Uncanny X-Men Vol. 6: Storyville (Trade Paperback)
description: CYCLOPS at a crossroads! Magneto...Matthew Malloy...the Last Will and Testament of Charles Xavier...AXIS...all of these pivotal events have driven this already tempestuous mutant to the edge of disaster. Will Scott Summers save himself from ruin or will he make that fateful leap?! COLLECTING: Uncanny X-Men #32-35, #600.

title: Old Man Logan (2016) #9
description: The night the villains joined forces and overcame the world’s heroes was the night that Wolverine’s life irrevocably changed. He lost his friends, his purpose, and all that was left was the Wasteland. Now, Old Man Logan has found himself in the past, before the Wasteland, and he lives with the fear that the Villain Uprising may yet come to pass. And he just may just be right.

title: Hyperion (2016) #5
description: “MATCH GAME” STARTS NOW! Hyperion is on a quest to discover what it truly means to be a human, and what it is to be a survivor. But as a lover, he is met with many more unexpected obstacles...especially when the woman he finds himself attracted to is none other than THUNDRA. Equal in strength, intelligence and skill...this couple could be the new powerhouse of the Marvel Universe, but not if they knew what was in store for their potential union. What they discover is the key to their attraction.

title: MARVEL SUPER HEROES SECRET WARS TPB (Trade Paperback)
description: Drawn from Earth across the stars, the Marvel Universe's greatest villains and heroes are set against one another by the mysterious and unbelievably powerful Beyonder, with the winner promised the ultimate prize. But as battle lines are drawn, new alliances forged and old enemies clash, one among them is not willing to settle for anything less than godhood. Can even the combined might of the Avengers, Spider-Man, the Fantastic Four and the X-Men prevent Dr. Doom from becoming the most powerful being in the universe? Collecting MARVEL SUPER HEROES SECRET WARS #1-12.

title: SPIDER-MAN: BIRTH OF VENOM TPB (Trade Paperback)
A-Force Presents Vol. 5 (Trade Paperback)
description: Amazing heroes in astonishing adventures! Black Widow races against time to thwart a dark plot threatening Europe. Captain Marvel rebels against an empire and declares a star war! jersey's new sensation, Ms. Marvel, hones her powers--and her costume! She-Hulk and Hellcat delve deep into the mysterious Blue File and dig up a Marvel Universe-wide conspiracy! The all-new Thor has her hands full with Absorbing Man and Titania--not to mention the de-hammered Odinson and his ever-cranky All-Father! Plus: Thrill to a selection of strange tails of the unbeatable Squirrel Girl! They're a force to be reckoned with and the "A" stands for "awesome!" COLLECTING: Black Widow (2014) #5, Captain Marvel (2014) #5, Ms. Marvel (2014) #5, She-Hulk (2014) #5, Thor (2014) #5, The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl (2015) #5.

title: The Astonishing Ant-Man (2015) #10
description: The epic conclusion of “Small Time Criminal”! It’s Ant-Man vs. Darren Cross vs. The Power Broker! Finally learn how Scott landed in prison. Seriously. We promise. Dragged that one out enough.

title: Deadpool: Too Soon? Infinite Comic (2016) #2
description: SOMEONE HAS MURDERED FORBUSH MAN! Could someone be targeting all of Marvel’s funniest characters for death? That’s what Deadpool thinks. Good thing Deadpool is renowned for his investigative skills!

title: All-New Wolverine (2015) #10
description: CIVIL WAR II TIE-IN! Which side will WOLVERINE choose when a terrible prophecy puts someone she loves into the crosshairs of her allies? How far is LAURA willing to go to protect her loved ones? Teaming up with OLD MAN LOGAN, Laura is prepared to fight the very future itself to change her destiny.

title: Spider-Man/Deadpool (2016) #7
description: Another guest issue while Joe Kelly and Ed McGuinness get ahead on their epic story! In the Deadpool tradition, we present a “lost” issue of the Amazing Spider-Man! Flashback to the swinging ‘60s for one of Deadpool & Spidey’s earliest meetings! Don’t be a flake – beat feet to your shop and order now! This issue is a real solid gas!

title: Captain Marvel Vol. 1: Rise of Alpha Flight (Trade Paperback)
description: Face front, true believers! The Captain has made her return and oh, how mighty it is. It's a bold new frontier for Carol Danvers as she soars to new heights in her greatest mission yet-leader of the all-new Alpha Flight space program. Yup, Alpha Flight. As earth's first line of defense, Carol and her team aim to protect the planet from extraterrestrial threats. But can Carol be a soldier and a diplomat? Especially when an unknown enemy emerges that Carol can't quite punch. The superstar team behind Marvel's Agent Carter television series, Tara Butters and Michele Fazekas, make their comics debut alongside the awesomely-talented Kris Anka. COLLECTING: CAPTAIN MARVEL (2016) #1-5.

title: Nighthawk (2016) #3
description: The city of Chicago explodes in racial violence, but the nightmare is just beginning. NIGHTHAWK goes to war against a group of white supremacists, but with the cops also hunting him, he may have finally bitten off more than he can chew. And then there’s that serial killer on the loose…

title: Deadpool & the Mercs for Money (2016) #1 (Nakayama Hip-​Hop Variant)
Rocket Raccoon & Groot Vol. 1: Tricks of The Trade (Trade Paperback)
description: There's a new criminal mastermind in the galaxy, and it's...ROCKET RACCOON?! How did this happen? SERIOUSLY, HOW DID THIS HAPPEN, YOU GUYS??? Groot knows, but he's not talking! Well, he is talking, but all he's saying is...oh, you know. Diabolical danger, madcap mysteries and astonishing adventure abound as SKOTTIE YOUNG and FILIPE ANDRADE return to tell tall tail tales of Rocket Raccoon, now with the adorable, arboreal Groot along for the ride! If you love adventure, animals, outer space and just about anything in between, this is the book for you! COLLECTING: ROCKET RACCOON & GROOT (2016) #1-6.

title: The Astonishing Ant-Man (2015) #10 (Frison Death of X Variant)
A-Force (2016) #7
description: After narrowly escaping a grisly death at the hands of one of their own, a weary but determined A-FORCE make bold moves to free NICO and the town from Countess’s control. However, saving the day is going to take more than just super-powered punches. A-FORCE is going to have to go deeper than that – changing Countess’s very mind – which is not exactly something super villains readily embrace. Meanwhile, developments with the team’s sparkly THOR rock A-FORCE to the core.

title: Deadpool & the Mercs for Money (2016) #1 (Young Variant)
Ultimates (2015) #9
description: CIVIL WAR II TIE-IN! The Ultimates race against time to stop the foretold coming of... The Macronaut! But behind the scenes, the cracks in the ultimate super-team are widening...and Thanos isn’t the only one waiting for his moment to strike.

title: Deadpool & the Mercs for Money (2016) #1
description: Deadpool is one of the best mercenaries on the planet. He may even be a passable Avenger—jury’s still out. But one thing’s for sure—Deadpool is a terrible team leader. Think we’re lying? Ask the Mercs for Money! Deadpool’s taken on a new high-paying mission to take out radioactive super villains...and his Mercs aren’t nearly as immune to radiation as his healing-factored heinie is. Deadpool veteran Cullen Bunn brings us mo’ mercs, mo’ money and naturally, mo’ problems.

title: Star Wars: Obi-Wan and Anakin (Trade Paperback)
description: Before their military heroism in the Clone Wars, before their tragic battle on Mustafar, and many decades before their final confrontation on the Death Star, they were Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and his young Padawan, Anakin Skywalker. Now join them a few years into the "chosen one" Anakin's training. Teacher and student have grown closer over time, but it's been a difficult road. And things aren't about to get any easier. In fact, when they are called to a remote planet for assistance, the pair may be pushed to breaking point. As they find themselves stranded on a strange world of primitive technology and deadly natives, will they be able to save themselves? First they must learn who called for help...and why! COLLECTING: OBI-WAN AND ANAKIN #1-5.

title: Darth Vader (2015) #23
description:
Vader vs. Morit on the shell of the Executor! DO YOU NEED MORE THAN THAT??? Fine: Cylo’s secret revealed!
