title: True Believers: Deadpool - Deadpool Vs. Sabretooth (2016) #1
description: Reprinting Deadpool (2015) #8!

title: Uncanny X-Men (2016) #10
description: “APOCALYPSE WARS” CONCLUSION! The villainous Apocalypse, accompanied by his Four Horsemen, once preached the gospel of “Survival of the Fittest.” And now, the Son of Apocalypse has reared his ugly head, joined by an army of Archangels of Death, hell-bent on preaching a gospel of his own: the Survival of NONE. Can Psylocke and Magneto save their teammate Archangel and prevent the maniacal GENOCIDE from living up to his name?

title: Black Widow (2016) #5
description: THE WEEPING LION’S HUNTING GROUND Using her darkest secret as leverage, the Weeping Lion has pushed Natasha further from the straight and narrow. And Agent Elder of S.H.I.E.L.D. is closing in — is he fellow prey that needs Black Widow’s protection, or another predator?

title: Patsy Walker, A.K.A. Hellcat! (2015) #8
description: CIVIL WAR II TIE-IN! When fallout from the battlefields of Civil War II hits close to home, Patsy is forced to take stock of her life as a hero — and to face what it really costs to be A.K.A. HELLCAT.

title: X-Men: The Trial of Gambit (Trade Paperback)
description:
For years, they have loved each other from a safe distance. Now Rogue and Gambit will become closer than ever - and it may shatter their lives permanently! For when Remy LeBeau's past actions are revealed, he will be put on trial - but who will serve as judge, jury and executioner? A suitably uncanny battle between Cannonball and Gladiator sends one squad of X-Men on their latest intergalactic adventure. Can they free the Shi'ar from the deadly grip of the Phalanx and return safely to Earth in one piece? 
COLLECTING: UNCANNY X-MEN (1981) #341-350, #-1; X-MEN (1991) #62-64, #-1.

title: All-New Inhumans (2015) #9
description: Gorgon stands trial! What crime could Gorgon have committed to land him in an Inhuman jail? And what does Ana Kravinoff have to do with it all?

title: Star Wars (2015) #21
description:
“The Last Flight of the Harbinger” STARTS NOW! Sgt. Kreel is back with an all-new squad of stormtroopers! Go inside the minds of an elite group of Imperial soldiers! Join incoming artist Jorge Molina for a walk on the dark side!
Star Wars © Lucasfilm Ltd. & TM. All rights reserved. Used under authorization. Text and illustrations for Star Wars are © 2016 Lucasfilm Ltd.

title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. Vol. 1: The Coulson Protocols (Trade Paperback)
description: It's high-stakes espionage in the Marvel Universe in this brand-new series inspired by the hit television show Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. The good news for Phil Coulson is that he's been reunited with his former love, Lola - who, it turns out, is not a flying car. The bad news is that she turned his mind into a weapon that could destroy the Marvel Universe! Tony Stark guest-stars!

title: Contest of Champions (2015) #10
description: Maestro’s team of dark Avengers were powerful enough to go toe-to-toe with the renegade Champions, but are they too powerful even for him?

title: Deadpool & the Mercs for Money (2016) #1 (Camuncoli Variant)
Squadron Supreme (2015) #9
description: OVERSIZED WARRIOR WOMAN Spectacular! Now that Warrior Woman has revealed her true identity to the Squadron Supreme, we focus on her life — her past, present and future — in a special solo issue. Now the ruler of her own country and sovereign leader of the Alien Myriad, Warrior Woman plans an even greater feat of world conquest. But to do this, it will first require a vision from the Profiler...and the resurrection of Namor, the Sub-Mariner. Also, learn the surprising fate of the Power Princess whose identity Warrior Woman stole. A CIVIL WAR II TIE-IN AND PRELUDE TO THE NEXT MAJOR STORY ARC “FINDING NAMOR.”

title: Howard The Duck: The Complete Collection Vol. 3 (Trade Paperback)
description: Discover rare, never-before-collected tales of the duck with delusions of adequacy as Marvel's trawl through the annals of Howard history plunders the magazine era! As rendered by legends like Gene Colan, John Buscema and Michael Golden, Howie has never looked better, while his adventures get wilder than ever. As for the stories, who could resist epics like "Of Dice and Ducks," "Captain Americana" and "Duck Soup"? Howard will reunite with muck monster Man-Thing and meet Santa Claus, and one of horror's greatest icons may leave a lasting impression: prepare for Drakula, the undead duck! It's enough to make a furious fowl head back home to Duckworld - and Beverly comes along for the ride! Plus: In the name of all that's decent, Howard puts on some pants! COLLECTING: Howard the Duck Magazine #2-7.

title: Uncanny X-Men (2016) #10 (Ward Death of X Variant)
Deadpool & the Mercs for Money (2016) #1 (Christopher Action Figure Variant)
Spider-Man (2016) #6
description: CIVIL WAR II TIE-IN! Miles Morales has only been in the Marvel Universe for a few weeks, and he’s already finding himself in the middle of a war. Which side will Miles choose?!

title: Guardians of Infinity (2015) #8
description: A COMIC OF TRULY COSMOS-IC PROPORTIONS! The GREATEST GUARDIANS this galaxy has ever known join forces to face a threat to free will — past, present and future! The FINAL TRIAL approaches! If any Guardians SURVIVE, can they escape with their bodies and minds intact? And Earth’s own SAGE OF THE STARWAYS, Dr. NEIL DEGRASSE TYSON brings you his take on the Guardians!!! Read it here BEFORE it’s translated into infrared radiation and beamed into space!

title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day - The Complete Collection Vol. 2 (Trade Paperback)
description: Will Spider-Man's Brand New Day be ruined by foes old, new, or a combination of the two? First, Spidey must survive Kraven's First Hunt - but this isn't the Kravinoff he knew. In fact, she might be even more lethal! Then, Spidey must face a Norman Osborn who has changed too - because this time Osborn has the force of the law behind him. And his dark version of order is maintained by the twisted Thunderbolts! COLLECTING: AMAZING SPIDER-MAN (1963) #565-577, ANNUAL (2008) #1; SECRET INVASION: THE AMAZING SPIDER-MAN #1-3.

title: The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl & The Great Lakes Avengers (Trade Paperback)
description: She kicks butts and eats nuts! They get stuck in ruts and shoot themselves in the foot(s)! But could Squirrel Girl be just what the Great Lakes Avengers need to propel them into the big leagues? Or will she be the death of them? The same questions apply to new foe/recruit Deadpool (who spills guts), but he's just playing second fiddle to 'dorable Doreen. Follow Squirrel Girl's complete adventures with the GLA (or is that GLI? GLX? GLC? It changes a lot!) COLLECTING: GLA #1-4, GLX-MAS SPECIAL, THING (2006) #8, CABLE & DEADPOOL #30, DEADPOOL/GLI SUMMER FUN SPECTACULAR; MATERIAL FROM MARVEL SUPER-HEROES (1990) #8, I HEART MARVEL: MASKED INTENTIONS, AGE OF HEROES #3, I AM AN AVENGER #1.

title: Nova (2015) #9
description: CIVIL WAR II TIE-IN! Nova comes to New York! Stuck between two sides of a war he doesn’t want to fight, Sam Alexander makes a tough choice.

title: Thunderbolts (2016) #3
description: The new Thunderbolts vs. the All-New Inhumans! Who needs diplomacy when there are faces that need punching?

title: Silk (2015) #10
description: It’s the battle of the century as Black Cat uncovers the truth about Silk’s allegiance!

title: Civil War II (2016) #3
description: This is the one everyone will be talking about! One of the biggest heroes in the Marvel Universe will fall! Who it is and how and why will divide fans for years to come. Will the heroes of the Marvel Universe survive the unthinkable happening? The fallout to this issue is enormous!

title: SPIDER-WOMEN (Trade Paperback)
description: SPIDER-GWEN, SPIDER-WOMAN and SILK come together for the Spider-Event of 2016! Jessica Drew, Spider-Woman, has decided to step-up her mentoring of the younger, less-experienced Gwen Stacy and Cindy Moon. But when the trio gets trapped in Gwen's Universe, at the hands of an alternate Cindy Moon and her sinister organization S.I.L.K., there's not time for any more practice. This action-packed story will change the heroic course for all three Spider-Women!

title: Civil War II (2016) #3 (Quesada Midnight Launch Wraparound Variant)
Web Warriors (2015) #9
description: The Web of Life and Destiny is damaged, and even worse – it’s getting TANGLED! How are the Web-Warriors supposed to repair REALITY ITSELF?! Join us for this insane web-hopping romp that features A GIANT SPIDER-MAN ROBOT FROM THE FARTHEST CORNER OF THE MULTIVERSE as a guest star!

title: WOLVERINE: OLD MAN LOGAN VOL. 1 - BERZERKER (Trade Paperback)
description:
Fifty years from now, Logan - the man who no longer calls himself Wolverine - will have endured many atrocities: The Marvel Universe's villains will have banded together and rid the world of its heroes. Logan's closest friend, Hawkeye, will have been murdered in cold blood right before his eyes. And driven mad by the same radiation that gave him his superhuman strength, Bruce Banner will have fathered a family of hillbilly Hulks...that eventually went on to slaughter Logan's wife and two children. But now, in the present, Old Man Logan wakes up to discover himself in a world before these atrocities, before the Wasteland. And he's going to seize this opportunity and change history to ensure that his future never comes to pass...

COLLECTING: Old Man Logan 1-4, Wolverine: Old Man Logan Giant-Size

title: Old Man Logan (2016) #8 (Albuquerque Death of X Variant)
Civil War II (2016) #3 (Michael Cho Dcd Black and White Variant)
Civil War II: Choosing Sides (2016) #2
description: A major loss sends shockwaves through the super hero community forcing everyone to reexamine their alliances…did they choose the right side? Featuring Nick Fury, War Machine and Tom Foster, a.k.a. Goliath!

title: Civil War II: Amazing Spider-Man (2016) #2 (Nauck Variant)
MARVEL UNIVERSE GUARDIANS OF THE GALAXY VOL. 2 (Digest)
description:
Star-Lord! Rocket! Groot! Gamora! Drax! Join your favorite guardians as they continue their adventures across the galaxy! See what happens when the team is forced to infiltrate a gang of weapons dealers known as...THE BLACK ORDER!

COLLECTING: MARVEL UNIVERSE GUARDIANS OF THE GALAXY 5-8

title: Deadpool (2015) #15
description: CIVIL WAR II TIE-INS! The Mercs for Money hate Deadpool and want out! Wait...isn’t there a new Mercs for Money series launching? How is that going to work?

title: Dark Tower: The Drawing of the Three - Bitter Medicine (2016) #4
description: STEPHEN KING’S SMASH-HIT FANTASY EPIC CONTINUES! ODETTA and DETTA’s struggle over their shared body comes to a head! ROLAND visits the assassin JACK MORT... and uses his body to get into a shootout with the police!

title: Daredevil Epic Collection: The Man Without Fear (Trade Paperback)
description: Born to a past-his-prime prizefighter, Matt Murdock's luck always ran a step behind his good intentions. When a daring act to save a man's life blinds young Murdock, he finds that the same accident has enhanced his remaining senses to superhuman levels! He becomes Daredevil, a gritty hero born from murder but tempered with the desire to protect the downtrodden.

title: All-New X-Men (2015) #11 (Bagley Death of X Variant)
Old Man Logan (2016) #8
description: The night the villains joined forces and overcame the world’s heroes was the night that Wolverine’s life irrevocably changed. He lost his friends, his purpose, and all that was left was the Wasteland. Now, Old Man Logan has found himself in the past, before the Wasteland, and he lives with the fear that the Villain Uprising may yet come to pass. And he just may just be right.

title: Power Man and Iron Fist (2016) #6
description: CIVIL WAR II TIE-IN! They’re off on a job — and it’s predicted to end with LUKE CAGE back in the place he hates most! The Marvel Universe has split in two — will the conflict split up POWER MAN and IRON FIST?

title: SCARLET BOOK 1  (Trade Paperback)
description: THE AWARD WINNING, BEST SELLING POWERHOUSE CREATIVE TEAM BEHIND DAREDEVIL, HALO, AND THE AVENGERS UNLEASH THEIR BOLDEST PROJECT YET! SCARLET! This is the comic experience of the year! The first creator-owned series by one of the most successful teams in all of modern comics. Scarlet is the story of a woman pushed to the edge by all that is wrong with the world...A woman who will not back down...A woman who discovers within herself the power to start a modern American revolution!!

title: Invaders (1975) #41
description: The Invaders barely survived their last encounter with Baron Blood. What will they do now that the Nazi vampire has returned?

title: Iron Man (1968) #126
description: DEMON IN A BOTTLE PART 7 The mastermind behind the failing Iron Man armor is finally revealed!

title: Thor (1966) #287
description: Sif versus Storm Giants! The Warriors Three versus Fafnir The Dragon! The Forgotten One versus the Celestials! Three epic, divine showdowns that cannot be missed!

title: Uncanny X-Men (1963) #125
description: Jean Grey is alive and well on Muir Island. When Cyclops learns the news of this, he also discovers that the security on Muir Island has been breached and that Lorna is in grave danger! How will the X-Men respond?

title: Master of Kung Fu (1974) #80
description: Shang-Chi must fight Fu Manchu's leopard cult of assassins, although his father turns out not to be dead after all!

title: Iron Man (1968) #125
description: DEMON IN A BOTTLE PART 6 As Tony continues to lose control over his armor and his life, a terrible accident occurs! Can Stark make it out of this unscathed?

title: Thor (1966) #286
description: When Odin denies Thor the aid he needs in a fight against deviants, the Thunder God is captured. With no backup in sight, Sersi makes a daring rescue attempt!

title: Marvel Premiere (1972) #49
description: When a Bodavian diplomat is murdered by the Silencer, the Falcon thinks he knows who's behind the mask.

title: Master of Kung Fu (1974) #79
description: The Master of Kung Fu must fight the drugs in his system in order to win his ongoing battle with Zaran.

title: Power Man and Iron Fist (1978) #58
description: A new vigilante named El Aguila is in town! Notorious for being a hero to the underprivileged, El Aguila faces crime with a sword that can shoot electricity! description: A normal bank heist thwarting turns south when Spidey is confronted by the mysterious new villain CARRION!

description: A change of pace: Shang-Chi gets a day off to reflect on his place in life, including Juliette's shocking admission.

description: Spider-Woman’s in dire straits! Defenseless against the magic of Morgan le Fay, Jessica finds that the captive Magnus is unable to help. title: Peter Parker, the Spectacular Spider-Man (1976) #22
description: Moon Knight follows a criminal named Lindy to prevent an assassination by the Maggia. Meanwhile, Spider-Man encounters one of Moon Knight’s multiple identities, Jack Lockley. title: Invaders (1975) #32
description: Hitler summons Thor from his native Asgard...to a hidden bunker in Third Reich Germany!

title: Master of Kung Fu (1974) #68
description: With Kogar in attendance, Shang-Chi has his final battle with Shen Kuei…A.K.A. the Cat!

description: If college academics weren't difficult enough during the day, imagine having to defeat the vicious Vulture by night!

title: Black Panther (1977) #2

Princes Zanda aligns herself with Panther and Abner Little to see Hatch-22 returned to the ‘Sixth Era of Man.’ But will Panther and company find the second Brass Frog in time? Black Panther will need to go to King Solomon's tomb to set right the wrongs unleashed by a dangerous artifact!

title: Master of Kung Fu (1974) #50
description: Shang-Chi and Clive Reston aren’t dead under the rubble of a fallen fortress -- they actually are on Fu Manchu's rocket ship! And now Shang-Chi must face his father’s rage!

title: Defenders (1972) #45

title: Ms. Marvel (1977) #2

title: Super-Villain Team-Up (1975) #10
description: Enter the Red Skull! Captain America follows a lead during the Avengers’ battle with Attuma. What dark secrets will Cap uncover about his deadliest villain? title: Peter Parker, the Spectacular Spider-Man (1976) #3
description: The first ever appearance of the "Lightmaster"! After Spidey is temporarily blinded by this foe, he must uncover the new villain's motivations.

title: Iron Fist (1975) #11
description: The Wrecking Crew crashes the New York City scene...quite literally! Alan Cavenaugh reflects on the sins of his past, while Misty Knight finds herself a hostage. Who is the Wrecking Crew really after? Jean Grey and Cyclops of the X-Men cameo!

title: Nova (1976) #6
description: Nova’s rogues join forces to destroy Nova! Also featuring the debut of the maniacal Sphinx!

title: Marvel Two-in-One (1974) #24
description: The Thing and Black Goliath team up for a face off with the Hijacker!

title: Deadly Hands of Kung Fu (1974) #33
description: The Daughters of the Dragon continue to defend the streets of China Town after a rash of violent crimes. Note: this issue only contains the Daughters of the Dragon story.

title: Defenders (1972) #44
description: The Defenders split up to look for the missing Doctor Strange!

title: Master of Kung Fu (1974) #49
description: Shaka Kharn, the demon warrior, was given life by Fu Manchu -- in order to bring death to his son, Shang-Chi!

title: Son of Satan (1975) #8
description: Daimon Hellstrom - defeated! Satan - supreme at last! But nothing is as it seems, as the Lord of Darkness will soon find out in this holiday special!

title: Fantastic Four Annual (1963) #12
description: A galactic adventure guest-starring the Inhumans!

title: Black Panther (1977) #1
description: Marvel legend Jack Kirby presents Black Panther in his first ongoing series! While helping Abner Little recollect a precious artifact, Black Panther runs afoul of the Collectors! And in the midst of the tussle…an ancient time machine is activated! Enter Hatch-22, a creature from a time and space unknown.

title: Nova (1976) #5
description: Nova must face down Tyrannus and his colossal Earth-Shaker robot! Even more frightening, Nova comes face-to-face with Stan Lee!

title: Ms. Marvel (1977) #1
description: Carol Danvers takes flight as the Kree-empowered Ms. Marvel!

title: Marvel Two-in-One (1974) #23
description: Thing and Thor's clash with Seth continues! But the wily god of death has another trick up his sleeve - a being known only as the DEVOURER!

title: Peter Parker, the Spectacular Spider-Man (1976) #2
description: Who wouldn't want to see Spider-Man battle an enemy in the world famous Central Park? Spidey must defeat Kraven the Hunter, a man of extreme physical prowess. Oh, and he has to face a few live, hungry tigers too.

title: Peter Parker, the Spectacular Spider-Man (1976) #2
description: Who wouldn't want to see Spider-Man battle an enemy in the world famous Central Park? Spidey must defeat Kraven the Hunter, a man of extreme physical prowess. Oh, and he has to face a few live, hungry tigers too.

title: Master of Kung Fu (1974) #48
description: Shang-Chi's everlasting fight against his father Fu Manchu continues in "The Bridge of a Thousand Dooms!"

title: Deadly Hands of Kung Fu (1974) #32
description: There’s a Kung Fu assassin terrorizing the streets of China Town, and it’s up to the Daughters of the Dragon to deliver justice! Colleen Wing and Misty Knight are the dearest of friends, and the closest of allies. Will the “Daughters” be able to defend themselves, and the public, from this Kung Fu menace? Note: this issue only contains the Daughters of the Dragon story.

title: Werewolf By Night (1972) #42
description: Crossover alert! Iron Man blasts his way into Jack Russell’s path! And just in time -- the Masked Marauder has come into possession of some dangerous tech!

title: Defenders (1972) #43
description: Nighthawk must convince the Hulk to carry Cobalt Man into New York Harbor to minimize the threat of Cobalt Man’s explosion!

title: Iron Fist (1975) #10
description: Iron Fist is on the lam after the Golden Tigers frame him for the murder of costumed hero William Hao. Misty Knight and Colleen Wing know the truth about Iron Fist, and will stop at nothing to help their friend and ally out of this sticky jam! Iron Fist vs. Chaka!

title: Super-Villain Team-Up (1975) #9
description: The Avengers are under the collar of Attuma, and their first mission is the elimination of Namor! Will the underwater monarch go on the lam from Earth’s Mightiest Heroes? Not a chance! Namor challenges Attuma head-on, while Doctor Doom exploits Iron Man’s fatal flaw.

title: Peter Parker, the Spectacular Spider-Man (1976) #1
description: You would think Spider-Man and a man named Tarantula would get along because of their arachnid similarities. Unfortunately…the Tarantula becomes one of Spidey's deadliest foes!

title: Nova (1976) #4
description: Thor has fallen under the mental domination of the Corruptor! Can the Human Rocket withstand the power of a thunder god?

title: Doctor Strange (1974) #20
description: Doctor Strange vs. Xander the Merciless! Clea loses control over her mystical abilities.

title: Marvel Two-in-One (1974) #22
description: Clash of the gods! Ben Grimm's partner in crime fighting is none other than the MIGHTY THOR! But even these two powerhouses may be outmatched against the Egyptian god Seth, and his armies of the dead!

title: Deadly Hands of Kung Fu (1974) #31
description: The fists of fury fly as White Tiger, Iron Fist, Shang-Chi, and Jack of Hearts take on the menace of the ‘Corporation’! Misty Knight guest-stars!

title: Defenders (1972) #42
description: While meeting at Doctor Strange’s Sanctum Sanctorum, the Defenders are attacked by Egghead's Emissaries of Evil!

title: Son of Satan (1975) #7
description: In the Court of Anubis, Mindstar reveals that he is actually Daimon's real estate agent, Silas Warden!

title: Master of Kung Fu (1974) #47
description: War in an Arctic wasteland! Shang-Chi alone can defeat the forces of his father Fu Manchu.

title: Marvel Two-in-One (1974) #21
description: The Thing teams up with a heroic pioneer, the legendary DOC SAVAGE! Together, they must beat back the menace of the mysterious BLACKSUN!

title: Iron Fist (1975) #9
description: Iron Fist finds a (very) worthy opponent in the Golden Tigers Gang. Leader Chaka shows his true colors, and swears to topple Ward Meachum. But why? Iron Fist accused of murder!

title: Defenders (1972) #41
description: Nighthawk and Doc Strange pack their bags for Nevada…to perform an exorcism! Kyle suspects that his oldest friend, Patricia ‘Trish’ Starr, is possessed by demons. Enter Shazana and her monstrous hordes, here to claim our dimension!

title: Nova (1976) #3
description: Nova may be strong, but can he defeat a foe made of pure diamond? And can Richard Rider stand up to the school bully?

title: Jungle Action (1972) #24
description: Series Finale! Black Panther is challenged by a new villain…Wind Eagle!

title: Werewolf By Night (1972) #41
description: Topaz...transformed into a vicious creature of myth! Meanwhile, Jack Russell may have just gained control of his lycanthropic abilities!

title: Master of Kung Fu (1974) #46
description: Shang-Chi takes on the unstoppable SUMO -- but are mere Kung Fu skills enough?

title: Deadly Hands of Kung Fu (1974) #30
description: The Swordquest Saga concludes here!

title: Defenders Annual (1976) #1
description: The Defenders are cast across the globe in this explosive annual! In Washington D.C., Doctor Strange must convince the President that Nebulon’s Mind Control Movement is not in the public’s best interest. Power Man and Valkyrie investigate mysterious deaths in India, while Nighthawk and Red Guardian take on a violent faction in France!

title: Skull the Slayer (1975) #8
description: The origin of Viracocha, Incan "god" revealed. What history does Captain Victor Cochran share with the Jaquar Priest? Villac Umu, Jaguar Priest, unleashes a dangerous coup, leaving Skull and his friends caught in battle.

title: Black Goliath (1976) #5
description: After being attacked by Stilt-Man with his Z-Ray, Black Goliath, Celia and her nephew find themselves spirited away to the distant planet of Kirgar.

title: Nova (1976) #2
description: Nova must face the supervillain duo of Powerhouse and the Condor! What are their nefarious plans for the neophyte hero?

title: Defenders (1972) #40
description: Valkyrie is reunited with her team, but the period of peace doesn’t last long! Hulk must stop a riot outside a movie theater, while Nighthawk throws money at Jack Norriss to make him go away. (Yes, Nighthawk's that annoyed). Matt Murdock guest stars as Valkyrie’s attorney!

title: Doctor Strange (1974) #19
description: Cosmic beings threaten to destroy the Universe. Doc suffers a blow by the Ancient One- is Stephen Strange Sorcerer Supreme no longer?

title: Incredible Hulk Annual (1968) #5
description: Hulk has an untimely brush with an associate of Xemnu's - Diablo!

title: Super-Villain Team-Up (1975) #8
description: Doctor Doom, prisoner of Namorita! Will Namor’s royal cousin prove more merciful than the King of Atlantis? And will Doom finally release Namor from the bonds of Latverian slavery? Find out in this turning point issue of Super-Villain Team-Up!

title: Iron Fist (1975) #8
description: New York City has been overrun by a Kung Fu street gang known only as the Golden Tigers. Sounds like the perfect case for mystical crime fighter Iron Fist! Danny Rand makes some inquiries into his father’s shadowy past. Will Rand ever find forgiveness for former mentor Yu-Ti?

title: Master of Kung Fu (1974) #45
description: The son of Fu Manchu must now defeat his sister's team of assassins

title: Son of Satan (1975) #6
description: After a bewitched blunder on his first day of teaching, Daimon Hellstrom makes a clairvoyant connection with Saripha – who reveals she is Wiccan.

title: Deadly Hands of Kung Fu (1974) #29
description: Shang-Chi, the Master on Kung Fu, partners with Iron Fist to save a damsel!

title: Iron Fist (1975) #7
description: Danny makes a shocking discovery about his mother’s demise. How was Iron Fist’s mystic mentor Yu-Ti involved in Heather Rand’s death? Colleen Wing returns to her senses, and teams-up with Iron Fist to take down Angar the Screamer and his brainwashed lackeys!

title: Marvel Two-in-One (1974) #19
description: Tigra meets Thing for the very first time. And she desperately needs his help.

title: Invaders (1975) #8
description: The life and death of Union Jack!  The mysteries of Britain's greatest World War II hero are revealed.  But can even the might of Union Jack and the Invaders stop Baron Blood?

title: Captain Marvel (1968) #46
description: Mar-Vell and The Supreme Intelligence in a battle of epic proportions!

title: Doctor Strange (1974) #18
description: Doctor Strange and Clea travel to the year 1775 where they board a ship headed to America- with Founding Father Benjamin Franklin in tow!

title: Defenders (1972) #39
description: The search for Valkyrie begins! Val's behinds bars, (and charged with destruction of property), but the Lady Liberator reaches her breaking point when prison conditions become intolerable. Valkyrie breaks out of solitary…to enter a prison riot!

title: Skull the Slayer (1975) #7
description: Our unlikely crew of heroes has no choice but to cooperate when taken captive by Supreme Inca, Viracocha. Will Skull and the scientists meet their end in the City of Gold? Ann Reynolds develops a brilliant plot involving pteranodons, while Jeff Turner’s father stages a rescue mission from the outside world. Will this be the twist of fate Skull desperately needs?

title: Deadly Hands of Kung Fu (1974) #28
description: The greatest Martial Arts Master stars in his own feature! Read this Bruce Lee Special!

title: Werewolf By Night (1972) #40
description: Topaz, Brother Voodoo and the Werewolf by Night are trapped in the deadly dimension of Dr. Glitternight!

title: Master of Kung Fu (1974) #44
description: It's father versus son once more, as Fu Manchu reappears in Death-Day of the Golden Dagger!

title: Jungle Action (1972) #23
description: Reprinting Daredevil (1964) #69: A Panther/Daredevil team-up set in New York City!

title: Super-Villain Team-Up (1975) #7
description: Henry Kissinger orders a ceasefire with Latveria, forcing the Fantastic Four back to American soil. Meanwhile, Namor senses an unusual presence; Enter Shroud, Marvel’s most mysterious mercenary! But why has Shroud agreed to take down Doom at the behest of Namor?

title: Doctor Strange (1974) #17
description: Doctor Strange and Clea time travel to 1618 London...where they meet the explorer of new worlds, Francis Bacon!

title: Defenders (1972) #38
description: Nebulon is up to his old tricks when he transports Strange, Red Guardian, and Power Man to his dimension of terrors! Jack Norriss and Kyle Richmond align themselves to save their teammates from a fate worse than death. The return of Nighthawk.

title: Iron Fist (1975) #6
description: Colleen Wing is played off as a pawn, forced into battle with her ally Iron Fist! Is this the end of Colleen Wing the hero? Iron Fist pulls out all the Kung Fu kicks he can, including a mystical mind-merge to reacquaint Colleen with her true memories. Master Khan makes his next move.

title: Marvel Two-in-One (1974) #18
description: Team-up between the Thing and the Scarecrow!

title: Son of Satan (1975) #5
description: Daimon Hellstrom is attacked by the assassin known as Mindstar!

title: Black Goliath (1976) #4
description: Tony Stark obsesses over the theft of his latest invention -- but for security reasons, he can't even tell Bill the purpose behind the device!

title: Master of Kung Fu (1974) #43
description: More martial arts mayhem as Shang-Chi faces an electrifying death at the hands of Shockwave!

title: Deadly Hands of Kung Fu (1974) #27
description: The White Tiger launches his own War on Crime…starting with a pack of gangsters!

title: Marvel Preview (1977) #7
description: The first appearance of Rocket Raccoon. Prince Wayfinder arrives on Witch World and finds himself face-to-face with the future Guardian of the Galaxy. Note: this issue only contains the Rocket Raccoon story.

title: Marvel Team-Up (1972) #47
description: Continued from Marvel Two-In-One (1974) #17! Part Two of Thing and Spidey’s battle against Basilisk!

title: Marvel Two-in-One (1974) #17
description: Peter Parker is busy doing homework when duty calls! Spider-Man and the Thing take on Basilisk!

title: Doctor Strange (1974) #16
description: Wong enlists the help of Lord Phyffe and Rama Kaliph to free Doctor Strange and Clea from hell where they are the captors of Satan!

title: Defenders (1972) #37
description: Doctor Strange and Red Guardian duke it out with Plantman’s giant, toxic flower. But when hallucinatory agents are added to the fray…all bets are off! Luckily Power Man is on the scene. Valkyrie struggles with her morality, and cellmates, behind bars.

title: Invaders (1975) #7
description: Baron Blood is out to end the Invaders as the fate of London hangs in the balance.  Thankfully, the Invaders get a little help from one of Britain's greatest heroes.

title: Deadly Hands of Kung Fu (1974) #26
description: It’s a terrifying Tiger-centric issue, as White Tiger and the Sons of the Tiger take center stage!

title: Jungle Action (1972) #22
description: Monica imagines what America’s Reconstruction Era would look like had Black Panther been involved.

title: Skull the Slayer (1975) #6
description: Skull and his friends continue to experience jumps in time despite escaping the Tower. With Raymond Corey facing grave injuries, will the crew slow down for a second? There’s no rest for the wounded and weary as Skull and company thwart an attack from an Incan tribe! Outside the Bermuda Triangle, a ghost from James Scully’s past resurfaces.

title: Astonishing Tales (1970) #36
description: Deathlok is hired by the C.I.A to eliminate a threat from Hellinger. During the mission, Deathlok discovers clones of Luther Manning, and must destroy each incarnation of himself!

title: Master of Kung Fu (1974) #42
description: Shang-Chi must defeat Shockwave in hand-to-hand combat before his time bomb detonates!

title: Captain Marvel (1968) #45
description: Captain Marvel has gone mad! Rick Jones, usually bonded with him on world-saving missions, is now Mar-Vell's biggest target!

title: Werewolf By Night (1972) #39
description: The Werewolf by Night fights Brother Voodoo!

title: Iron Fist (1975) #5
description: Colleen Wing’s location is still classified, but Iron Fist is determined to blow the cover and rescue his friend. But before Danny can track Colleen, he must thwart an attack from angered civilians! Iron Fist makes ties to the IRA…but how? Colleen succumbs to the brainwashing powers of Angar the Screamer!

title: Doctor Strange (1974) #15
description: A mysterious visitor craves Strange's tutelage as mystical guide. Satan emerges!

title: Defenders (1972) #36
description: Tania Belinskaya is the Red Guardian! After performing a successful brain transplant on Norriss, Strange ensures that the Russian super woman can stay in America. Valkyrie encounters a moral dilemma in prison, while Kyle Richmond finds himself in hot water once again! What does Plantman want with Nighthawk? The Defenders can have their teammate back…to the tune of five million dollars!

title: Civil War II: Amazing Spider-Man (2016) #2
description: Ulysses made a shocking prediction that someone in Spider-Man’s life would turn traitor… and it isn’t who you’d expect! The folks at Parker Industries already had one mole in their midst, another could destroy everything Peter’s worked to build! Good thing Peter’s got his old pal, Harry Osborn by his side, right? …Right?

title: THE TOTALLY AWESOME HULK VOL. 1: CHO TIME (Trade Paperback)
description:
There's a brand-new Hulk in town, and his name is Amadeus Cho! Get ready for gamma-fueled entertainment as the kid genius decides he's gonna be the best Hulk ever -and just possibly brings the entire world crashing down into chaos! Cho is taking on the biggest monsters in the Marvel Universe, but can he handle the danger posed by Lady Hellbender? What will She-Hulk and Spider-Man make of this very different Green Goliath? And what exactly happened to Bruce Banner? With monster mayhem in the Mighty Marvel Manner, all from the wild and crazy minds of Planet Hulk writer Greg Pak and superstar artist Frank Cho, this is better than incredible, it's totally awesome! Plus: Amazing Science during Secret Wars featuring the Amadeus Cho of Battleworld!

COLLECTING: The Totally Awesome Hulk 1-6, Planet Hulk (2015) 1 (B story)

title: All-New X-Men (2015) #11
description: “APOCALYPSE WARS” CONCLUSION! Destined to one day become the next host of the genocidal villain Apocalypse, Evan Sabahnur is determined to change his fate. And now, thousands years in the past, in Ancient Egypt, Evan has allied himself with En Sabah Nur, the boy who will one day become Apocalypse himself! But will the lessons Evan learns in the past seal his fate…or enable him to avert it?

title: Guardians of the Galaxy (2015) #10
description: GALAXY’S MOST WANTED comes to its rip-roaring conclusion! The Guardians are rejoined by ANGELA!!!

title: New Avengers (2015) #13 (Veregge Death of X Variant)
MARVEL MASTERWORKS: MS. MARVEL VOL. 2 (Hardcover)
description:
Chris Claremont weaves complex plots and compelling characterization in our second Ms. Marvel Masterworks, concluding Carol Danvers' original adventures! The highlights are many: Ms. Marvel meets the Avengers for the very first time! Mystique makes her first appearance! A battle with Ronan the Accuser brings Ms. Marvel and Captain Marvel together, and leads to an all-new look for our heroine!

COLLECTING: MS. MARVEL (1977) 15-23; MARVEL SUPER-HEROES (1990) 10-11; AVENGERS (1963) 200, AVENGERS ANNUAL (1967) 10 AND MATERIAL FROM AVENGERS (1963) 197-199 AND MARVEL FANFARE (1982) 24

title: Rocket Raccoon & Groot (2016) #7
description: PUTTING THE FUN BACK IN FUNERAL! I’m SORRY — you found that poor in taste? Well, maybe we’re using humor to avoid facing our grief over the death of Rocket Raccoon’s mentor in con-artistry! Who’s insensitive NOW? Did you even KNOW Rocket had a confidence-man mentor? Look, let’s start over and try to be more understanding. It’s a new era for the Guardians of the Galaxy’s most non-humanoid characters, and we’re kicking it off with this story by NICK KOCHER of comedy duo BriTANicK, so of CORPSE it’s going to DIE-larious! We’re just going to miss this character — an all-new insight into Rocket’s mysterious past — so much!

title: The Unbelievable Gwenpool (2016) #4
description: M.O.D.O.K. is on to Gwen’s totally powerless/skill-less nature! Can she escape his wrath with no powers or skills to speak of? I wouldn’t think so! But she IS unbelievable.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy (2015) #10 (Skan Death of X Variant)
True Believers: All-New, All-Different Avengers - Cyclone (2016) #1
Vision (2015) #9
description: Every family has its share of secrets – skeletons in the closet, kept hidden from the world at large. For the Visions, those secrets are real, actual skeletons. The thing about secrets is they always have a cost… and one of the Visions is going to pay with their life.

title: MARVEL FIRSTS: THE 1990S VOL. 2 (Trade Paperback)
description: The notorious Nineties roll on! The decade's biggest stars - Venom, Cable, Deadpool and Gambit - win solo titles! The clone-tacular Scarlet Spider swings in as another webhead debuts, '90s style -that's 2090s! The Avengers and Fantastic Four get Force-ful spinoffs, as do Thor and Iron Man! Generation X joins the Xavier School! Blade and the Nightstalkers rise!

title: Civil War II (2016) #3
description: This is the one everyone will be talking about! One of the biggest heroes in the Marvel Universe will fall! Who it is and how and why will divide fans for years to come. Will the heroes of the Marvel Universe survive the unthinkable happening? The fallout to this issue is enormous!

title: Silk (2015) #10
description: It’s the battle of the century as Black Cat uncovers the truth about Silk’s allegiance!

title: Civil War II (2016) #3 (Quesada Midnight Launch Wraparound Variant)
SPIDER-WOMEN (Trade Paperback)
description: SPIDER-GWEN, SPIDER-WOMAN and SILK come together for the Spider-Event of 2016! Jessica Drew, Spider-Woman, has decided to step-up her mentoring of the younger, less-experienced Gwen Stacy and Cindy Moon. But when the trio gets trapped in Gwen's Universe, at the hands of an alternate Cindy Moon and her sinister organization S.I.L.K., there's not time for any more practice. This action-packed story will change the heroic course for all three Spider-Women!

title: Web Warriors (2015) #9
description: The Web of Life and Destiny is damaged, and even worse – it’s getting TANGLED! How are the Web-Warriors supposed to repair REALITY ITSELF?! Join us for this insane web-hopping romp that features A GIANT SPIDER-MAN ROBOT FROM THE FARTHEST CORNER OF THE MULTIVERSE as a guest star!

title: Ultimate Spider-Man Infinite Comic (2016) #5
description: Trapped in the clutches of Hydra scientist Armin Zola and his army of Synthzoids, Iron Man seems to be in over his head! What hope does Peter Parker have against a foe that took down an Avenger? Luckily, he’s not just Peter…he’s the Ultimate Spider-Man!

title: Captain America: Sam Wilson (2015) #11
description:
CIVIL WAR II TIE-IN!
With the battle lines forming, Sam must choose a side.

title: Marvel Universe Avengers: Ultron Revolution (2016) #1
description: THE BAND IS BACK TOGETHER! As the Avengers unite once more, they’ll have to relearn how to work as a team. And they’d better figure it out quickly before Ultron’s master plan kicks into high gear! If that weren’t enough, the Scientist Supreme unveils the latest deadly creation from AIM!

title: The Amazing Spider-Man (2015) #15
description: “Power Play” comes to its rousing conclusion! Regent’s master plan is working until Mary Jane Watson gets into the fray!

title: Spider-Woman (2015) #9
description: CIVIL WAR II TIE-IN! Spider-Woman has history with both sides of CIVIL WAR II, so things are more complicated than just picking a side. Plus, she’s got her baby to consider now, and she can’t risk her life putting him in harm’s way. But Jess has never been one to just sit on the sidelines.

title: Vote Loki (2016) #2
description: Presidential candidate Loki Laufeyson is finding it hard to roll with the punches of the campaign trail. As if proving his eligibility isn’t hard enough, the media has started the HORRIBLE rumor that his Super P.A.C. is actually a cult under Loki’s control! Plus, the Marvel heroes finally figured out how to successfully fight Loki in his new role: attack ads. God bless (Captain) America, eh?

title: Invincible Iron Man (2015) #11
description: On the road to CIVIL WAR II! During the last Civil War, Tony Stark and Captain America battled to the bitter end. Now they find themselves on the same side. Or do they? It is Steve Rogers and Tony Stark like you have never seen them before.

title: Han Solo (2016) #2
description:
Han Solo has entered the space race of his dreams – the DRAGON VOID! But he’s on an undercover mission – to find a traitor within the Rebellion. Teamed with Wookiee warrior Chewbacca, will they be able to find the mole before trouble finds them?

title: Civil War II: Kingpin (2016) #1 (Mckelvie Black Panther 50th Anniversary Variant)
Deadpool V Gambit (2016) #2
description: Deadpool and Gambit have put aside their differences to pull one last scam…swindling an object of mythical power out from under a Chinese businessman. Spoiler: It doesn’t go according to plan. Can they talk their way out of this one?

title: The Punisher (2016) #3
description: STRAIGHT TO HELL! On the trail of horrific drug EMC, FRANK CASTLE lands on the doorstep of a crew of bloodthirsty Appalachian warriors. But the leader of the group knows THE PUNISHER’s brutal style, and is prepared to fight fire with fire…on an innocent bystander! In the midst of the carnage, how will Frank weigh the crimes of CONDOR against the life of an innocent?

title: Civil War II: X-Men (2016) #2
description: An Inhuman with the power to profile the future has emerged, upsetting the delicate balance of power between the Inhuman and Mutant nations. And the mutant master of magnetism, MAGNETO refuses to allow his people to fall by the wayside. Now, Magneto rallies those who would follow him to even the scales…even if it means risking war with Inhumans and Mutants alike to do it!

title: Daredevil/Punisher (2016) #3
description: Getting to the airport is always a hassle. Getting a Russian mobster to the airport for trial relocation while avoiding The Punisher and mob associates can be deadly! Daredevil has trained Blindspot well, but nothing can prepare him for what will happen next!

title: Amazing Spider-Man: Worldwide Vol. 2 (Trade Paperback)
description: One of Spider-Man's most terrifying villains, MISTER NEGATIVE, has followed him to Shanghai. In Mister Negative's service are two beloved Marvel heroes. Wait, TWO HEROES?! What is Mister Negative's plan and how did he convince two fan-favorite heroes to join him? COLLECTING: AMAZING SPIDER-MAN (2015) #6-11.

title: Marvel's Doctor Strange Prelude (2016) #1
description: MARVEL’S OFFICIAL PREQUEL! A powerful, ancient relic has been stolen from the British Museum – a relic that could do significant damage in the wrong hands…Enter the MASTERS OF THE MYSTIC ARTS! The team is on a mission to find the relic and the mysterious mystic who stole it – but will they be able to track her down before it’s too late?!

title: The Amazing Spider-Man (2015) #15 (Js Campbell Exclusive Black and White Variant)
Moon Knight (2016) #4
description: “NOT IN BLOOD, BUT IN SAND.” MARC SPECTOR and his fellow asylum patients — FRENCHIE, GENA and MARLENE — finally reach street level. But Marc doesn’t see streets. He sees New York City sinking in the sands of NEO-EGYPT! How much of himself — and how many more friends — will Marc lose before he reaches his true enemy?

title: Civil War II: Kingpin (2016) #1 (Guice Bam Variant)
Captain America: Steve Rogers (2016) #1 (Saiz 2nd Printing Variant)
Deadpool: Too Soon? Infinite Comic (2016) #1
description: What do you get when you cross Deadpool, Forbush Man, Squirrel Girl, Spider-Ham, The Punisher, Ant-Man, Howard the Duck, Rocket and Groot? Murder, madness, mystery, and mayhem! Marvel’s biggest WHODUNIT yet!

title: Invincible Iron Man (2015) #11 (Gedeon Death of X Variant)
Scarlet Witch Vol. 1: Witches’ Road (Trade Paperback)
description: Witchcraft is broken - and the SCARLET WITCH is on a journey across the globe to fix it. From the back alleys of Manhattan, to the serene Greek Isles, to the bustling streets of Hong Kong, Wanda will have to face down her foes and find out who her true friends are. But as Wanda solves magical crimes and pieces witchcraft back together, the most important question remains: Who is the mastermind that broke it in the first place? COLLECTING: SCARLET WITCH #1-5.

title: The Totally Awesome Hulk (2015) #8
description: CIVIL WAR II TIE-IN! BRUCE BANNER was cured from his gamma-irradiated curse...AMADEUS CHO thought he was smart enough to handle the curse! Is he one in a long line of HULKS that face certain tragedy?

title: Captain America: Steve Rogers (2016) #1 (Veregge Hip-​Hop Remix 2nd Printing Variant)
CIVIL WAR II: ULYSSES INFINITE COMIC (2016) #2
description: Ulysses has been dispatched to hone and better understand his powerful precognitive gifts at the hands of the mysterious KARNAK! What awaits Ulysses within Karnak’s ominous Inhuman fortress, the TOWER OF WISDOM?

title: Scarlet Witch (2015) #8
description: A day in the life of WANDA MAXIMOFF! After coming face to face with her biological mother, Wanda explores her early memories and attempts to reconcile with the sins of her past. But meanwhile, little does she know that a traitor lurks in her very midst...!

title: A-Force Vol. 1: Hypertime (Trade Paperback)
description: What do you do when a sentient cosmic event rampages through Japan? ASSEMBLE A-FORCE! Marvel's newest hero, SINGULARITY, has escaped Battleworld and found her way to the Marvel Universe! But she didn't make the journey alone. To combat the villainous ANTIMATTER, Singularity will call upon Earth's mightiest team of Avengers. And one thing's for sure: They are A FORCE to be reckoned with! COLLECTING: A-Force #1-4, Avengers #0 (A-Force story), Avengers (1963) #83, A-Force (2015) #1.

title: Silver Surfer (2016) #5
description: SILVER SURFER #200! Oversized anniversary issue! After Norin Radd’s massive status quo change in the 50th Anniversary issue (no spoilers!), it’s now Dawn Greenwood’s turn. With one simple act of kindness, the Surfer may have forever changed her world. What’s going on? Why is San Francisco overrun by monsters? And what wall-crawling, web-spinning guest-star is swinging by to help out? (Okay, we’ll tell you that one! It’s Peter Parker, THE AMAZING SPIDER-MAN!) All this and tons of cosmic weirdness, surprise super heroes, and special stories as we celebrate the 200th Silver Surfer issue!

title: The Amazing Spider-Man (2015) #15 (Js Campbell Exclusive Variant)
Hawkeye & The Thunderbolts Vol. 2 (Trade Paperback)
description: Earth's mightiest marksman continues to steer the Thunderbolts to greatness, in a volume filled with revelations! Citizen V is unmasked at last! A heartbreaking killer is exposed! And Moonstone learns far more than she bargained for about the source of her power! As the team enters a showdown with the V-Battalion, Sandman lends a great big hand - but can he be trusted? Wonder Man has it in for Atlas, and Black Widow swings by - could this be a warm-up for a full-on Avengers/Thunderbolts crossover? You betcha! And Count Nefaria might be more than both groups can handle! COLLECTING: THUNDERBOLTS (1997) #38-50, AVENGERS (1998) #31-34.

title: Spidey (2015) #8
description: Spidey vs. Electro! And this time, Electro is powered by all the electricity of New York City!

title: Empress (2016) #4
description: Emporia and her children are stranded on barren planet Golgoth without hope of escape, shrouded by a massive dust cloud. When two scumbag scrap-merchants think they can make a quick buck selling Emporia’s kids as slaves, the family is torn apart again and left fighting for their lives.

title: Captain America: Steve Rogers (2016) #1 (Steranko Spotlight 2nd Printing Variant)
Spider-Man 2099 (2015) #12
description: THE FUTURE LOOKS SINISTER…Trapped in an unfamiliar 2099, Miguel is reunited with those he loves through an unexpected team-up. But Spider-Man is not home free — this era’s Sinister Six still have unfinished business with the anachronistic arachnid. Can Spidey trust his new allies? Or is he caught in a web of lies?

title: Star Wars: Poe Dameron (2016) #4
description: The next stop on Poe’s mission is Grakkus the Hutt…But Grakkus has been in Republic Prison for years. You know what that means—POE DIRECTLY TO JAIL!

title: Civil War II: Kingpin (2016) #1
description: An Inhuman with the ability to predict the future has helped the heroes of the Marvel Universe clamp down on crime before it can even happen. While this thwarts most criminals, one man has found a way to keep doing what he does best. Wilson Fisk has managed to stay one step ahead of the good guys and his crime enterprise is BOOMING. But what’s his secret?! Rising stars Matthew Rosenberg (We Can Never Go Home) and Ricardo Lopez Ortiz (Wolf) present a gritty, street-level view of CIVIL WAR II starring the Kingpin in a world without crime!

title: Ultimate Spider-Man Infinite Comic (2016) #4
description: Peter Parker, the Ultimate Spider-Man, has cred. Like working-with-Iron-Man-to-defeat-Hydra cred. Or he would… if Iron Man would just let him help out!  When Iron Man goes off to fight Arnim Zola, evil scientist extraordinaire, will Peter get his shot to step in and save the day?

title: Angela: Queen of Hel - Journey to The Funderworld (Trade Paperback)
description: Hel hath a new fury! She was stolen from Asgard, exiled from Heven, and robbed of her greatest companion - now Angela plunges into the blackest depths to save Sera. But once there, the lost princess will claim a throne of her very own. To rescue her beloved, Angela must conquer this domain and rewrite laws as old as death! All hail Angela, the new Queen of Hel? Not if the old Queen, Hela, has anything to say about it. When Angela and Sera come face-to-face at last, will their reunion be joyous - or tempestuous? Who else will join this rebellion in the underworld? COLLECTING: ANGELA: QUEEN OF HEL (2015) #1-7.

title: Spider-Man (2016) #5
description: BLACK CAT makes her move against SPIDER-MAN!!!

title: The Amazing Spider-Man & Silk: The Spider(Fly) Effect (2016) #4
description: Spidey and Silk’s time jaunt takes them all the way to their beginning...the science fair where they were bitten by the radioactive spider! Plus: Chronosaurus Rex revealed!

title: Thunderbolts Classic Vol. 2 (Trade Paperback)
description: The Thunderbolts' true identities have been revealed to the world. Baron Zemo's plans for global domination have been put into effect. The world's greatest super-heroes have fallen under his control. Only the Thunderbolts can stop things from escalating before it's too late...but are these former villains willing to side with the angels just yet? COLLECTING: Thunderbolts #6-14 and Heroes For Hire (1997) #7.

title: Star-Lord (2015) #8
description: MAKING UP IS HARD TO DO! Especially when you and your ex are being held captive by THE COLLECTOR! And he wants to acquire the story of your breakup for his personal use! So GROSS! WHAT DOES THAT EVEN MEAN?! Can Kitty and Peter come together to defeat this cosmic conundrum, or will their house divided be unable to stand?!

title: Haunted Mansion (2016) #4
description: THERE’S ONLY ONE WAY OUT – PAST HER! The Captain’s power is growing—and Danny’s enemies are closing in! There’s only one chance for Danny to get out of the mansion now, but he’ll need to make his way through the attic…where Constance the Bride is at her most deadly

title: Carnage Classic (Trade Paperback)
description: The serial-killing symbiote's sadistic spree starts here! As if Venom wasn't lethal enough, imagine what would happen if his symbiotic "other" had been joined to a murderous psychopath? That's where Cletus Kasady comes in, as Venom's symbiotic spawn transforms him into Carnage, Spider-Man's sickest foe! Killing on a whim, Carnage is a painful, twisted thorn in the sides of Peter Parker, Ben Reilly, Venom...even the Silver Surfer! COLLECTING: AMAZING SPIDER-MAN (1963) #361-363, #410, #430-431; VENOM: CARNAGE UNLEASHED #1-4; CARNAGE: MIND BOMB; CARNAGE: IT'S A WONDERFUL LIFE; SENSATIONAL SPIDER-MAN (1996) #3; SPIDER-MAN (1990) #67; SPECTACULAR SPIDER-MAN (1976) #233; PETER PARKER: SPIDER-MAN (1999) #13; WEBSPINNERS: TALES OF SPIDER-MAN #13-14.

title: X-Men: Worst X-Man Ever (2016) #5
description: What becomes of the worst X-Man ever? Journey decades into the future and find out! Is it possible for things to actually get worse for Bailey?

title: Venom: Space Knight (2015) #9
description: VENOM VERSUS VENOM! The time has come--Flash is face to face with the Klyntar. Perhaps things will end amicably?…Perhaps not.

title: Hyperion (2016) #4
description: Flip the switches and light the lights — the carnival is open for business. HYPERION and Doll have a final showdown with the freaks and weirdos of the dark carnival of Valentine County, but the real danger is what lurks inside the haunted house. Something awaits within those twisted walls. Something that wants very badly to be free.

title: A YEAR OF MARVELS: JULY INFINITE COMIC (2016) #1
description: Celebrating the Fourth of July is complicated enough for a patriotic symbol turned soviet assassin, but then Hydra agents had to go and rob the Winter Soldier’s secret storage locker. Who sent them? What do they want? Bucky doesn’t care — he just wants his #$%& back.

title: Venom: Space Knight Vol. 1 - Agent of The Cosmos (Trade Paperback)
description: Flash Thompson is many things. Soldier. Veteran. Double amputee. Host to a powerful alien symbiote. Guardian of the Galaxy. Now Flash is tasked with being an intergalactic ambassador of Earth and an Agent of the Cosmos! Join Flash for high adventure in deep space as he swashbuckles his way across the universe! But as Venom travels the galaxy, helping the helpless and punishing the violent, he is being trailed by a mysterious warship. COLLECTING: VENOM: SPACE KNIGHT #1-5.

title: Uncanny X-Men: Superior Vol. 1 - Survival of The Fittest (Trade Paperback)
description: Desperate times call for a darker team of X-Men! With mutantkind in extinction's crosshairs once more, Magneto leads a group of the deadliest that homo superior has to offer to fight for the fate of their species! Refusing to accept even one more mutant death, the most ruthless possessors of the X-gene on Earth -deadly warriors such as Sabretooth, Fantomex, Mystique and Psylocke -have banded together to proactively mow down their enemies. But with a team populated by killers, can they stay away from each other's throats long enough to take down their targets? And can the Master of Magnetism curb his own homicidal instincts long enough to find out who's trying to speed up mutantkind's descent into the grave? It's X-Men with the emphasis on Uncanny! COLLECTING: UNCANNY X-MEN #1-6.

title: Silk (2015) #9
description: With Silk’s life turned upside-down by the events of SPIDER-WOMEN, she’s not sure what to do. I’m pretty sure running more robberies with Black Cat is the wrong choice.

title: Spider-Man/Deadpool (2016) #6
description: Deadpool goes Hollywood! See the M w/the M on the set of his own MOVIE! And he brings his pal Spidey along, as he has lots of experience selling out! All-Star Special Issue—written by Scott Aukerman of TV’s Comedy Bang Bang!

title: Timely Comics: Uncanny Inhumans (2016) #1
description: Re-printing Uncanny Inhumans (2015) #1 (A story), #2-3!

title: Black Panther (2016) #3
description: The most anticipated Marvel series since Whedon & Cassaday’s Astonishing X-Men! The Midnight Angels continue the liberation of Wakanda with extreme prejudice, and T’Challa’s indecisions could cost him more than just the throne. Coates and Stelfreeze weave a quintessential Black Panther tale that will change the tapestry of the Marvel Universe forever.

title: Starbrand & Nightmask: Eternity's Children (Attend University) (Trade Paperback)
description: They're former Avengers with tremendous power, but almost zero life experience. Now Starbrand and Nightmask are out on their own, trying to find their place as heroes, cosmic entities and...students? College -it's a whole new universe for this pair, posing more questions than their mid-term exam. Can two all-powerful friends share a tiny dorm room? How hard is intergalactic teleportation after partying all night long at your first kegger? And will they keep their grades up while putting bad guys down? Time to find out, along with Starbrand & Nightmask! COLLECTING: STARBRAND & NIGHTMASK #1-5.

title: All-New, All-Different Avengers (2015) #11
description: The Avengers--captives on the Stalag of Space! Its mysterious alien warden cannot be beaten by conventional means, but the Avengers’ prison break will take them into an even more dangerous realm!

title: Timely Comics: Web Warriors (2016) #1
description: Reprinting WEB-WARRIORS (2015) #1-3!

title: The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl (2015) #9
description: The comic that got TWO #1s in its first year now reaches a new milestone: its very first #9! In Part 2 of “I Kissed A Squirrel And I Liked It,” Squirrel Girl’s date with a chump gets interrupted by MOLE MAN, who is a man who lives underground and can’t see that well! Hence the name!! Squirrel Girl is really good at empathizing with bad guys and talking them down, but what happens when she’s TOO good at that? Buy this comic to find out, because we show exactly that taking place! Spoiler alert: there’s punches AND jokes. Not a dream! Not an imaginary story! ONE the following three things WILL ACTUALLY OCCUR in this issue! 1) A pleasant visit to a coffee shop with friends; 2) A man with fishy powers suggests using fish to solve a problem, big surprise; 3) SQUIRREL GIRL USES HER TAIL TO KNOCK THE SMIRK RIGHT OFF A DUDE’S FACE!! Haha whoa I hope it’s the third one

title: The Infinity Entity (Trade Paperback)
description:
When last we saw Adam Warlock, he was a captive of Annihilus of the Negative Zone. So where do we find him now? Hanging with the Original Avengers? Then things start getting weird. But what else would you expect from the cosmic team of Jim Starlin and Alan Davis? Guest-starring the Guardians of the Galaxy. 
COLLECTING: THE INFINITY ENTITY #1-4, MARVEL PREMIERE #1.

title: Avengers: Standoff (Hardcover)
description: On his 75th anniversary, Captain America is about to face a challenge unlike any other. Prepare for an assault on...Pleasant Hill! Three shield-wielders past and present - Steve Rogers, Bucky Barnes and Sam Wilson - find themselves in a standoff, with high and very personal stakes. And this tense conflict quickly escalates out of control, drawing in several Avengers teams! But it all begins in the small town of Pleasant Hill. An idyllic community with friendly neighbors...and a terrible, dark secret. What is going on behind Pleasant Hill's closed doors, and how will Captain America react? COLLECTING: WELCOME TO PLEASANT HILL PROLOGUE #1, ASSAULT ON PLEASANT HILL ALPHA #1, AGENTS OF S.H.I.E.L.D. #3-4, UNCANNY AVENGERS #7, ALL-NEW, ALL-DIFFERENT AVENGERS #7-8, NEW AVENGERS #8-10, CAPTAIN AMERICA: SAM WILSON #7-8, UNCANNY AVENGERS #8, ILLUMINATI #6, HOWLING COMMANDOS #6, ASSAULT ON PLEASANT HILL OMEGA #1.

title: Captain Marvel (2016) #6
description: CIVIL WAR II TIE-IN! Old friends face off as enemies in an event that will change Captain Marvel’s life forever. As war erupts, Carol finds herself at the forefront of battle. But after tragedy hits too close to home, how far will Carol go to fight for what she believes in? This is Captain Marvel at her finest. In her toughest fight yet.

title: Spider-Gwen Annual (2016) #1
description: The first ever SPIDER-GWEN ANNUAL is here and it’s huge. Threads for the next year of SPIDER-GWEN are laid down here in these stories: SPIDER-GWEN and CAPTAIN AMERICA go on a secret mission! THE MARY JANES get loud! CAPTAIN STACY and GWEN meet SHE-HULK?! SPIDER-HAM!!!

title: Ultimates: Omniversal Vol. 1 - Start with The Impossible (Trade Paperback)
description: Black Panther! Captain Marvel! Ms. America! Spectrum! Blue Marvel! Together, they form the ultimate super team, finding and fixing problems beyond the limits of the infinite! From cosmic forces lurking on Earth to whatever waits beyond the omniverse - they start with the impossible and take it from there! And what's more impossible than ending the threat of Galactus...forever? The devourer of worlds is beyond good and evil. He's a necessary part of the universe. When Galactus hungers, living worlds must die. The Ultimates have heard it all before, and respectfully they disagree. The bigger they are, the harder they fall -but if they succeed in taking him down, what will take his place? Another problem: Space-time is broken. And to solve that, the Ultimates must think outside the box like never before! COLLECTING: ULTIMATES #1-5, AVENGERS #0.

title: Iron Fist (1975) #5
description: Colleen Wing’s location is still classified, but Iron Fist is determined to blow the cover and rescue his friend. But before Danny can track Colleen, he must thwart an attack from angered civilians! Iron Fist makes ties to the IRA…but how? Colleen succumbs to the brainwashing powers of Angar the Screamer!

title: Doctor Strange (1974) #15
description: A mysterious visitor craves Strange's tutelage as mystical guide. Satan emerges!

title: Defenders (1972) #36
description: Tania Belinskaya is the Red Guardian! After performing a successful brain transplant on Norriss, Strange ensures that the Russian super woman can stay in America. Valkyrie encounters a moral dilemma in prison, while Kyle Richmond finds himself in hot water once again! What does Plantman want with Nighthawk? The Defenders can have their teammate back…to the tune of five million dollars!

title: Super-Villain Team-Up (1975) #6
description: Absconded away to Latveria, Namor must remain a loyal servant to Doom, or meet his death. Will the Fantastic Four intervene in Doom’s latest attempt at world domination? You bet!

title: Marvel Two-in-One (1974) #16
description: A Savage Land adventure! Thing and Ka-Zar Vs. a mighty T-Rex!

title: Master of Kung Fu (1974) #41
description: Martial arts madness in the mighty Marvel manner - featuring appearances from M'Nai and Cho Lin!

title: Deadly Hands of Kung Fu (1974) #25
description: Swordquest starts here! Meet Shimuru Kurasu, a fearsome samurai with a unique destiny!

title: Son of Satan (1975) #4
description: On the first night in the dorms of his new job, Daimon is visited by the oracle Proffit who foresees an ill fate for Daimon and his new coworker, Saripha Thames.

title: Black Goliath (1976) #3
description: Vulcan and his men break into Stark Industries to steal a potential deadly weapon!

title: Marvel Two-in-One (1974) #15
description: Morbius the Living Vampire and the Thing band together as one deadly duo.

title: Invaders (1975) #6
description: The Liberty Legion show up at the Invaders darkest hour as they are forced to fight Captain America and his team...who are being controlled by the maniacal Red Skull!

title: Captain Marvel (1968) #44
description: Fawn alerts Mar-Vell of Rick Jones' condition, and the Captain rushes to the rescue!

title: Doctor Strange (1974) #14
description: Doc Strange, transformed into that which he fears most- a vampire!

title: Defenders (1972) #35
description: Jack Norriss, reunited with his brain at last! Doctor Strange calls in a Russian neurosurgeon for the most complicated procedure of his career. Chondu is trapped in a transient state…and it’s taken quite a toll on his body!

title: Jungle Action (1972) #21
description: The Panther intervenes at a Ku Klux Klan rally. What happens next is a historic showdown you can’t miss!

title: Power Man (1974) #31
description: Piranha Jones takes Power Man as his prisoner!

title: Skull the Slayer (1975) #5
description: Skull becomes de-facto leader of the crew, despite mistrust all around. The battle in Camelot rages on, as Black Knight and Skull take on Morgan Le Fay. But why are the scientists fighting on Morgan’s side? Skull and his comrades make a hasty escape from the Tower of Time, but not before discovering a shocking secret about Black Knight and the rest of Arthur's court!

title: Deadly Hands of Kung Fu (1974) #24
description: Iron Fist does battle for the Bird of Fire!

title: Astonishing Tales (1970) #35
description: Deathlok discovers a way to switch his mind and body with Simon Ryker. Driven to madness in Deathlok’s body, Ryker is no longer a threat. With Ryker destroyed, Deathlok accepts a new mission from the C.I.A. But will Luther Manning lose his humanity as he continues to be a weapon-for-hire?

title: Werewolf By Night (1972) #38
description: A new arc for Jack Russell! Will Werewolf by Night help a desperate father seeking custody of his baby daughter?

title: Master of Kung Fu (1974) #40
description: Shang-Chi, the son of Fu Manchu, battles his father's league of deadly assassins in "The Murder Agency!"

title: Super-Villain Team-Up (1975) #5
description: Namor in custody of the Fantastic Four! After Doom pulls the wool over his eyes, (and the air from his lungs), Namor recounts his failed alliance to the FF. Namor plots his revenge against the Latverian overlord, but his failing health puts him in grave danger! Will Doom relinquish the cure for Namor?

title: Doctor Strange (1974) #13
description: Doctor Strange is the only survivor after the destruction of the planet! Can he convince Eternity to restore Earth back to it's former glory?

title: Defenders (1972) #34
description: Hulk fears the worst when his beloved pet Bambi goes missing. Nebulon explains his extraterrestrial plans to “Nighthawk”.  What exactly is a Celestial Mind Control Seminar?

title: Iron Fist (1975) #4
description: London’s on the verge of a radioactive melt-down, as Iron Fist takes on Radion! Danny Rand must call on his K'un-Lun teachings to heal himself, and find the spiritual guidance necessary to take down his worst foe yet. Who was Henri Sorel before he was a being of pure energy? Your answers revealed in this issue!

title: Son of Satan (1975) #3
description: The Possessor has his plan to take over Hell from under Satan's feet, but not if the Son of Satan can help it!

title: Black Goliath (1976) #2
description: Black Goliath battles the Atom Smasher and Warhawk!

title: Master of Kung Fu (1974) #39
description: It's Shang-Chi versus the Cat in the Master of Kung Fu’s most equally-skilled match yet!

title: Power Man (1974) #30
description: Luke looks down the barrel of Cockroach Hamilton’s custom shotgun!

title: Deadly Hands of Kung Fu (1974) #23
description: Iron Fist continues to duke it out with Dhasha Khan! Meanwhile, Hector Ayala struggles in his White Tiger persona.

title: Defenders (1972) #33
description: The Defenders brace themselves for full mind/body swaps courtesy of the Headmen. But the team won’t go down without a fight! Chondu’s trapped in the body of Bambi. All that and an alien abduction!

title: Thor (1966) #245
description: With the world in ruins, Thor and his companions - along with the Tomorrow Man and his Servitor - make a last-ditch effort to save the fate of not only Zarrko's world, but also that of all worlds. But will even a trip to the end of time be enough to stop the awesome chain of events that threatens every living being? The Thunder God is faced with challenges unlike any seen before in this, the ultimate chapter of the Saga of the Time Twisters!

title: Invaders (1975) #5
description: Enter: the Red Skull!  The scourge of World War II is sent to destroy Captain America and the Invaders...and he just might succeed!

title: Captain Marvel (1968) #43
description: The Supreme Intelligence brings Captain Marvel and Drax the Destroyer out to a desolate moon to confront one another!

title: Deadly Hands of Kung Fu (1974) #22
description: Who is Jack of Hearts? Learn his incredible history here! Is White Tiger truly the killer Jack has made him out to be?

title: Jungle Action (1972) #20
description: Members of the KKK capture Black Panther, tying him to a burning cross!

title: Skull the Slayer (1975) #4
description: The scientists and Skull take a beating in the Tower of Time, an alien construct filled with dimensional wormholes. But when the three scientists seemingly perish at the hands of Slitherouge, guardian of the Tower, it’s up to Skull to save the mission! Skull the Slayer thrown into the Arthurian court of Camelot! Guest-starring Merlin and the Black Knight.

title: Astonishing Tales (1970) #34
description: After failing to detach an explosive on his wrist, Deathlok loses his bionic arm and much of his body. Mike Travers, anti-hero, manages to retrieve Deathlok’s body from the blast and takes him to the C.I.A for tinkering. There, Deathlok is re-programmed with one mission operative; take down Simon Ryker once and for all. Ryker re-invents himself as the half-cyborg, Savior Machine.

title: Iron Fist (1975) #1
description: The saga of Iron Fist begins here! Marvel's mystical Kung Fu crime fighter takes center stage in his own ongoing series. First thing on-tap? Rescuing Detective Colleen Wing! Iron Man guest stars, (and dukes it out with Iron Fist.)

title: Werewolf By Night (1972) #35
description: As we learn more of how Belaric Marcosa lived, we also learn about how he died. Will the gang escape from this haunted house before it’s too late?

title: Jungle Action (1972) #18
description: PANTHER’S RAGE CONCLUSION: T’Challa is attacked and held captive by Killmonger’s ‘better’ half, Madam Slay!

title: Master of Kung Fu (1974) #34
description: Shang-Chi and Clive Reston fly to Mordillo's secluded island in the East China Sea to find Leiko.

title: Skull the Slayer (1975) #2
description: Man-on-the-run James Scully, along with a team of scientists, have flown straight into a Bermuda Triangle time-warp! How will Scully and his new comrades navigate a prehistoric world of dinosaurs? A discovery from an ancient alien race unleashes the power of Skull the Slayer. The transformation begins here, but will it also end? The saga of the man trapped 250 million years in the past continues!

description: Knowing that Col. Ryker has ties to the mob, Deathlok shoots down a helicopter transporting a mobster who may have pertinent information. Will Deathlok’s trail run dry when the mob man swears to protect Ryker’s whereabouts?
